monsters.name: oozing tentacle
monsters.desc: Ooze pours out of this disgusting tentacle.
monsters.descZh: 粘液从这个恶心的触手中渗出。

monsters.name: ungolmor
monsters.desc: Largest of all the spiderkin, its folds of skin seem nearly impenetrable.
monsters.descZh: 它是体型最大的蜘蛛，它褶皱的皮肤看起来牢不可破。

monsters.name: Ak'Gishil
monsters.desc: This Blade Horror has been infused with intense temporal magic, causing its power to increase dramatically. Rifts in space open around it constantly, summoning and banishing blades before vanishing as quickly as they appear.
monsters.descZh: 这只刀锋般的恐魔生于强大的能量漩涡中，并逐渐掌握了时空之核。它能够不断的撕裂空间，召唤出成群的刀刃在其身周飞舞。

monsters.name: Arch Zephyr
monsters.desc: The robes of this ancient vampire billow with intense winds. Bolts of lightning arc along its body. In its hand it holds a bow, electricity streaking across it.
monsters.descZh: 这只远古吸血鬼的长袍无风自动。闪电在他的周身环绕。他手里握着一把长弓，电弧在这把弓上流转。

monsters.name: Aletta Soultorn
monsters.desc:
What once must have been an enchantingly beautiful Higher woman now looks to be a ghost of utter despair. Her thin, elegant form ripples gently in the air, whilst her tattered robes seem oddly still. The ghost's face looks jittery and pained whilst her wild, glowing eyes move rapidly back and forth in their sockets.
Now and then she seems to see something and her jaw pulls back, her whole face splitting apart as she shrieks an unholy cry of pain and torment.
monsters.descZh:
这只幽灵以前肯定是一位高等人类美人。她瘦弱而优雅的身躯在空中轻轻的摇晃，但是她的长袍却始终紧贴着身体。她的脸部除了疯狂便是万分的痛苦，她的眼睛在眼眶里不安的来回转动。
有时她会看到一些东西，她的下巴会突然收缩，分裂的脸部会发出一阵充满痛苦和折磨的哀嚎。

monsters.name: Amakthel's Hand
monsters.desc:
You never thought this could even exist. You certainly never thought you'd encounter it. But this is true, in front of you stands a piece of Amakthel himself.
The god that myths say was slain by the Sher'tul, themselves nothing but a myth.
But there it is, half alive, half dead but you can feel his thoughts in your head, there is no mistake: #{bold}#The Dead God is here!#{normal}#
monsters.descZh:
你从没想象这样的事情居然会发生，你不相信你居然会遇到它。但是这是真的，在你面前矗立着的就是阿马克泰尔肢体的一部分。
神话说，夏·图尔人杀死了阿马克泰尔，他们已经消逝在神话中。
但是他就在这里，处于生死交接的沉眠中。你可以在脑海中感受到他的思维，没有错：#{bold}#已死之神就在这里！#{normal}#

monsters.name: retaliator of Atmos
monsters.desc: This steam giant carries a steamgun in each hand. She is here to eliminate any and all aggression towards the Atmos tribe.
monsters.descZh: 这个蒸汽巨人双手各拿着一把蒸汽枪。她来此唯一的目的就是消灭任何对阿特姆斯部落的威胁。

monsters.name: banshee
monsters.desc: It is a ghostly woman's form that wails mournfully.
monsters.descZh: 一个发出凄惨尖叫的女妖。

monsters.name: elvala guard
monsters.desc: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

monsters.name: Elandar
monsters.desc: Renegade mages from Angolwen, the Sorcerers have set up in the Far East, slowly growing corrupt. Now they must be stopped.
monsters.descZh: 叛逃安格利文的法师，恶魔法师建立于远东并缓慢成长。现在他们的末日来临了。

monsters.desc: A stocky dwarf, he looks angry.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的矮人守卫，他看起来脾气火爆。

monsters.name: dwarven earthwarden
monsters.desc: A stocky dwarf, he looks angry.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的矮人守卫，他看起来脾气火爆。

monsters.name: The Eidolon
monsters.desc: A ripple in the void that somehow seems... alive, this creature stares at you with interest.
monsters.descZh: 看起来更像是一团虚无的活生生的……光，这只生物对你很感兴趣。

monsters.name: eldritch eye
monsters.desc: A small bloodshot eye floats here.
monsters.descZh: 一只小小的充血眼球，它游荡在这里。

monsters.name: Linaniil, Supreme Archmage of Angolwen
monsters.nameZh: 安格利文超阶魔导师·莱娜尼尔
monsters.desc: A tall, pale woman dressed in a revealing silk robe. Her gaze is so intense it seems to burn.
monsters.descZh: 一位穿着暴露丝绸长袍的高挑、白暂的女性。她的目光是如此的炽热，似乎会融尽一切。

monsters.name: umbral horror
monsters.desc: A dark shifting shape stalks through the shadows, blending in seamlessly.
monsters.descZh: 一个闪过黑暗的阴影，迅速遁入了无尽的黑暗。

monsters.name: The Shade
monsters.desc: This skeleton looks nasty. There are red flames in its empty eye sockets. It wields a nasty sword and strides toward you, throwing spells.
monsters.descZh: 这只骷髅看起来很邪恶。它的眼眶里有红色的燃烧火焰。它手持一把大剑冲向你，并向你投掷法术。

monsters.name: arcane blade
monsters.desc: A Human Arcane Blade. His body shows multiple scars from battle.
monsters.descZh: 一位人类奥术之刃。他的周身在战斗中不断的变换颜色。

monsters.name: cutpurse
monsters.desc: The lowest of the thieves, this cutpurse is just learning the tricks of the trade.
monsters.descZh: 盗贼中最低等的人群，他们仅仅会一点欺诈的小技巧。

monsters.name: white jelly
monsters.desc: A strange white blob on the dungeon floor.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的一团白色胶状物体。

monsters.name: white wolf
monsters.desc: A large and muscled wolf from the northern wastes. Its breath is cold and icy, and its fur coated in frost.
monsters.descZh: 一头来自北部荒野的狼，它膘肥身健，体型匀称。它的呼吸冰冷而急促且全身都凝结着冰霜。

monsters.name: white ooze
monsters.desc: It's white and it's oozing.
monsters.descZh: 又白又粘的软泥怪。

monsters.name: giant white ant
monsters.desc: It's a large white ant.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的白蚁。

monsters.name: white crystal
monsters.desc: A formation of white crystal. It emits bright white, chilling light.
monsters.descZh: 一个由白色水晶构成的生物，它散发着冰冷的黑色气息。

monsters.name: whitehoof invoker
monsters.desc: Vortexes of sickly arcane energies circle this great undead frame.
monsters.descZh: 不详的奥术能量环绕着这个强大的死灵。

monsters.name: whitehoof ghoul
monsters.desc: It is a cross between a human and a bull, but more ... dead.
monsters.descZh: 他像是人类和公牛组合出来的，除了更……死。

monsters.name: whitehoof hailstorm
monsters.desc: The air seems to freeze and wither around this terrible undead.
monsters.descZh: 看上去这个可怕的死灵身周的空气都冻结凋零了。

monsters.name: half formed drem
monsters.desc: A small faceless humanoid with vaguely Dwarven features.  Its waraxe and shield look battered, rusted, and generally in ill repair.
monsters.descZh: 身材矮小且拥有部分矮人特征的人形怪物。它的战斧和盾牌看起来又锈又钝，几乎从未修理过。

monsters.name: Half-Mechanized Yeti
monsters.desc: Whoever tortured and tormented this yeti did an amazing job of pain and destruction. As you gaze upon its fur you notice several vital spots reinforced with stralite plating. One of its arms has been replaced with a steamsaw.
monsters.descZh: 虽然不知道是谁把这个雪人折磨成这样，它的确变成了一个恐怖的杀戮机器。当你凝视着它的皮毛，你注意到它身上的重要部分都被蓝锆石装甲所覆盖。他的一只手臂也被替换成了蒸汽链锯。

monsters.name: halfling pyremaster
monsters.desc: This tiny ball of fiery hatred came to the Sunwall as reinforcement from the Allied Kingdoms. He shall regret it!
monsters.descZh: 这团火热的小球看来是联合王国派来支援太阳堡垒的援军。他一定会后悔来到这里的！

monsters.name: halfling citizen
monsters.desc: A clean-looking Halfling resident of Last Hope.
monsters.descZh: 一位面容清秀的最后希望市民。

monsters.name: halfling guard
monsters.desc: A Halfling, with a sling. Beware.
monsters.descZh: 一位携带投石索的半身人。当心。

monsters.name: halfling slinger
monsters.desc: A Halfling slinger. He seems adept at combat.
monsters.descZh: 一位半身人投石者，他似乎很擅长角斗。

monsters.name: halfling slinger
monsters.desc: A Halfling, with a sling. Beware.
monsters.descZh: 一位携带投石索的半身人。当心。

monsters.name: halfling student
monsters.desc: A halfling student.
monsters.descZh: 一个半身人学徒

monsters.name: halfling gardener
monsters.desc: A Halfling, he seems to be looking for plants.
monsters.descZh: 一名正在寻找植物的半身人。

monsters.name: half-dead forest troll
monsters.desc:
Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
He looks hurt.
monsters.descZh: 绿皮丑陋的生物，这只笨重的人形生物在盯着你并握紧了满是肉瘤的绿色拳头。他看起来受伤了。

monsters.name: half-dead forest troll
monsters.desc:
Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
He looks hurt.
monsters.descZh: 绿皮丑陋的生物，这只笨重的人形生物在盯着你并握紧了满是肉瘤的绿色拳头。他看起来受伤了。

monsters.name: Fortress Shadow
monsters.desc: The shadow created by the fortress, it resembles somewhat the horrors you saw previously, but it is not the same.
monsters.descZh: 堡垒制造的阴影，就像你之前看到的恐怖生物一样，不过显然它们有着本质的区别。

monsters.name: bursting entropic shard
monsters.desc: A strange tall crystal pusling with nether energies. It's broken. Tentacles come out of it to get you! #{bold}#RUN!#{normal}#
monsters.descZh: 一团发射出虚空能量的高大水晶。它的破裂处伸出触手抓向你。#{bold}#快跑!#{normal}#

monsters.name: polar bear
monsters.desc: This huge white bear has wandered south in search of food.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨大的白熊正在向南寻找食物。

monsters.name: Berethh
monsters.desc: This is Berethh, your old friend. He is dressed in well-worn leather and skillfully wields a bow. There is something noble about the way he carries himself but his expression carries no emotion.
monsters.descZh: 这是贝里斯，你的老朋友，久经沙场的皮甲和长弓显示着他的实力。他平静的表情透露出大义凛然的气势。

monsters.name: Captured Yeti Behemoth
monsters.desc: This yeti towers over even the trolls. Blind rage maddens its eyes.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨大的雪人远远高出附近的巨魔，极度的狂怒让它变得疯狂。

monsters.name: awoken tentacle tree
monsters.desc: The tentacle tree has awakened!
monsters.descZh: 触手树醒来了！

monsters.name: awoken tentacle tree
monsters.desc: One of the tentacle tree has awakened!
monsters.descZh: 触手树活起来了！

monsters.name: enthralled slave
monsters.desc: A slave.
monsters.descZh: 一名奴隶。

monsters.name: Corrupted Oozemancer
monsters.desc: This blight-ridden troll was once a proud defender of Nature. His corruption is spreading, eating away at the forest around him.
monsters.descZh: 这个被枯萎能量污染的巨魔曾经是大自然骄傲的守护者。他身上的污染正在扩散，吞噬了他周围的森林。

monsters.name: captive krog
monsters.desc: How this giant, this force of Nature has been captured and subdued is proof that the necromancers are not to be treated lightly.
monsters.descZh: 这位巨人，自然力量的化身竟然被人抓获并俘虏。显然，死灵法师们的力量不能轻视。

monsters.name: corrupted war dog
monsters.desc: This is a large dog, bred and trained for fighting. Something about the way it moves doesn't look normal.
monsters.descZh: 这是一条老练的猎犬，被培育和训练用于战斗。不过，他运动起来的方式似乎有些不太正常。

monsters.name: Ben Cruthdar, the Cursed
monsters.nameZh: 被诅咒者本·克鲁塞达尔
monsters.desc:
This madman looks extremely dangerous. He wields a big axe and means to use it.
A gloomy aura emanates from him.
monsters.descZh: 这个疯子看起来相当危险。他手持巨斧并精通战技。黑暗光环从他身上向周围扩散。

monsters.name: Ben Cruthdar, the Abomination
monsters.nameZh: 本·克鲁塞达尔，憎恶形态
monsters.desc: This crazed madman seems twisted and corrupted by temporal energy, his body shifting and phasing in and out of reality.
monsters.descZh: 这个疯子似乎被时空能量所扭曲，他的肉体不断的出入相位现实。

monsters.name: Heavy Sentinel
monsters.desc: A towering creature, made from the bones of countless bodies. An aura of flame billows from within its chest.
monsters.descZh: 像铁塔一样的生物，由数不清的骨头构成。它的胸前缠绕着一圈烈焰。

monsters.name: weaver young
monsters.desc: A tiny arachnid that phases in and out of reality.
monsters.descZh: 一只小小的蜘蛛，它在不断的出入相位现实。

monsters.name: weaver hatchling
monsters.desc: A nearly translucent spider hatchling.
monsters.descZh: 一只小小的蜘蛛，它在不断的出入相位现实。

monsters.name: mutant snake
monsters.desc: This snake seems to... thrive... in the polluted water of the sewers.
monsters.descZh: 这种蛇看起来在这片污染的下水道里…生活得很兴旺嘛。

monsters.name: Norgos, the Frozen
monsters.desc:
This ancient bear long guarded the western side of the forest, but as of late he started growing mad, attacking even the Thaloren.
It seems to have fallen prey to the shivgoroth invading the area. Dead and frozen, it seems like a statue, animated by the elementals.
monsters.descZh:
这只远古巨熊一直守护着西边的丛林，但是不知何时他变的疯狂并到处攻击自然精灵们。
它似乎已经成为了进入这片领地的寒冰元素的牺牲品，死去并且冻结，就像一座雕塑，被元素能量所支配。

monsters.name: cold drake
monsters.desc: A mature cold drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条成年冰龙，拥有冰冷刺骨的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: cold drake hatchling
monsters.desc: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
monsters.descZh: 一条幼龙。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

monsters.name: ice wyrmic
monsters.desc: An ice wyrmic aspiring to win the tournament. He comes paired with a fire wyrmic.
monsters.descZh: 一位立志赢得比赛的冰龙战士。他常和一位炎龙战士一起。

monsters.name: ice wyrm
monsters.desc: An old and powerful cold drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条年长且强大的冰龙，拥有冰冷刺骨的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: icy orc wyrmic
monsters.desc: A fierce soldier-orc trained in the discipline of dragons.
monsters.descZh: 一个彪悍的、经过龙战士训练的兽人。

monsters.name: cryomancer
monsters.desc: An archmage specializing in ice magic.
monsters.descZh: 一位精通冰系法术的法师。

monsters.name: The Glass Golem
monsters.desc: A huge golem-like construct made entirely out of glass. It seems to be the custodian of the whole castle and likely the key to those nice looking chests around the throne.
monsters.descZh: 这是一个巨大的机械傀儡，完全由玻璃制成。它似乎是整个城堡的卫士，看守着王座周围的宝箱。

monsters.name: disfigured creature
monsters.desc: A vaguely humanoid shape, wandering around to some unknown goals.
monsters.descZh: 一团不成型的生物，正在无目的地游荡。

monsters.name: Unspeakable Thing
monsters.desc: Through idiotic pride, one of the students has called this thing to your world. Thick, impenetrable darkness billows from its form, devouring all light around it. As the darkness touches you, you feel only one thing... Hunger. Bottomless, infinite hunger, as vast and unending as the void of space itself.
monsters.descZh: 一位学徒因为愚蠢的骄傲而错误的把这样东西召唤到了你的世界。深不可测的黑暗从他的身边喷涌而来，吞噬着周围的一切光芒。当黑暗触及你的时候，你只感受到一件事…饥饿，无尽的饥饿，如同宇宙的虚空一样广阔而无穷无尽。

monsters.name: brecklorn
monsters.desc: A giant hairless bat with the face of a Dwarf twisted into a constant scream.  Pustulant sores cover its malformed body, and your heart weakens as it nears.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的无毛蝙蝠，它有着一张不停尖叫且扭曲的矮人脸。躁狂症症在它畸形的身体内蔓延，当它靠近时，你感觉心跳都快停止了。

monsters.name: tailor
monsters.desc: This yeek has all sorts of cloth to sell.
monsters.descZh: 这名夺心魔出售所有种类的衣服。

monsters.name: multi-hued crystal
monsters.desc: A formation of multi-hued crystal. It shines with all the colors of the rainbow.
monsters.descZh: 一个由各色水晶构成的生物，它通体散发着彩虹般的光芒。

monsters.name: overpowered greater multi-hued wyrm
monsters.desc: An old and powerful multi-hued drake, armed with many deadly breath weapons and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条年长且强大的七彩龙，拥有许多致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: Lady Zoisla the Tidebringer
monsters.nameZh: 潮汐毁灭者佐西拉夫人
monsters.desc: Water circles slowly on the ground around this naga's tail, some droplets leaping up now and then as if they are impatient to do their mistress' bidding. Her dark tail is coiled tight, making her look short, but her calm and confident stare assure you that she will not be easily overcome. As the water begins to rise around her the air starts to shimmer, and you feel her dark eyes are penetrating into you deeper than is comfortable.
monsters.descZh: 水流缓慢的围绕着这位娜迦的尾巴旋转，有些水柱在不安的跳动，似乎它们迫不及待去执行主人的命令。她黑色的尾巴蜷缩起来，使她看起来较为矮小，但是她沉着而自信的脸庞使你感受到她无所畏惧。当水流在她周围蒸腾时，星空都仿佛失去了光芒，你感到她的眼神看穿了你的内心。

monsters.name: fiery orc wyrmic
monsters.desc: A fierce soldier-orc trained in the discipline of dragons.
monsters.descZh: 一个彪悍的、经过龙战士训练的兽人。

monsters.name: pet yeti
monsters.desc: This yeti is somewhat smaller than the average yeti, and its fur seems well groomed. Nonetheless, it looks quite unhappy to see its master's home invaded.
monsters.descZh: 这个雪人比一般的雪人要小一些，它的毛发看起来被梳理过。不仅如此，它看起来对它主人的家园被入侵了不太高兴。

monsters.name: Gerlyk, the Creator
monsters.desc:
During the Age of Haze nearly all gods were destroyed by the Sher'tul Godslayers. However, a small number escaped.
Gerlyk, the creator of the Human race, prefered to flee into the void between the stars than to face death. He has been trapped ever since.
The sorcerers tried to bring him back and nearly succeeded.
Now you have come to finish what the Sher'tul began. Become a Godslayer yourself.
monsters.descZh:
在混沌纪几乎大部分神祗被夏·图尔的弑神者所杀。但仍有少部分逃离。
盖里克，人类缔造者，则选择走进群星间的虚空来避免死亡。他至今仍毫无踪迹。
恶魔法师们正在试图将他召回，并已经接近成功。
现在是你结束夏·图尔人未完成事业的时刻了，去成为一名弑神者吧！

monsters.name: weaver matriarch
monsters.desc: A large dark blue arachnid with a shifting yellow and white pattern on its thorax.  It shifts and shimmers as though only partially connected to the timeline.
monsters.descZh: 一只胸部有着白色花纹的巨大黄蜘蛛。它不断的移动和闪烁，好像它只有部分连接在时间线上。

monsters.name: Animated Sword
monsters.desc: Time seems to warp and bend around this floating weapon.
monsters.descZh: 时空在其周围扭曲。

monsters.name: assassin
monsters.desc: Before you looms a pair of eyes... a glint of steel... death.
monsters.descZh: 只见眼前闪过一道……金属光芒……你死了。

monsters.name: daelach
monsters.desc:
You can only guess at the real shape of this demon. Its body is surrounded by a cloud of fiery darkness.
It moves swiftly toward you, casting terrible spells and swinging its weapons at you.
monsters.descZh: 你无法猜测这只恶魔的真实形态。它的身体被一层炽热的黑暗所笼罩。它向你发起快速的冲锋，同时向你发射致命的法术。

monsters.name: Grand Corruptor
monsters.desc: An Elven corruptor, drawn to these blighted lands.
monsters.descZh: 一位堕落精灵，他生活在这片荒芜大陆上。

monsters.name: Grand Corruptor
monsters.desc: An Elven corruptor, drawn to these blighted lands.
monsters.descZh: 一位堕落精灵，他生活在这片荒芜大陆上。

monsters.name: hummerhorn
monsters.desc: A giant buzzing wasp, its stinger dripping venom.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的黄蜂，它的尾刺滴着毒液。

monsters.name: Prox the Mighty
monsters.desc: A huge troll, he might move slowly but he does look dangerous nonetheless.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的巨魔，虽然他行动缓慢，但是毫无疑问他看起来危险无比。

monsters.name: Arch-Merchant Kaltor
monsters.desc: A well dressed giant, covered in gold, gems and fineries. Also wielding nasty looking guns at his sides. He seems to look strangely friendly while eyeing your gold purse.
monsters.descZh: 一个精心打扮的巨人，身穿珠光宝气的外衣。他的手中拿着着两把奇怪的枪。不过奇怪的是，他看起来对你比较友好，并盯上了你装满钱的钱包。

monsters.name: Grand Necromancer
monsters.desc: You can hardly believe your eyes, standing in from of you as the grand master of the necromancers is a lich.
monsters.descZh: 你不敢相信你的眼睛，在你面前死灵法师们的领袖竟然是一个巫妖。

monsters.name: mass of parasitic leeches
monsters.desc: Dozens - hundreds maybe? - of blood-gorged worms, of varying shapes and sizes, making a writhing, ichor-soaked sea of tooth-lined maws and sickly green skin, ready to latch onto you and drink until they burst or your veins run dry.
monsters.descZh: 几十个，也许几百个？各种形状和大小的血腥蠕虫，形成一个扭动的，布满锋利牙齿的血盆大口和生病的绿色皮肤组成的脓水海洋，随时准备缠住你并吸你的血，直到它们胀破或着你的静脉干涸。

monsters.name: greater hethugoroth
monsters.desc: A swirling mass of hot vapour animated into a semblance of life.
monsters.descZh: 一个灼热的蒸汽漩涡所形成的生命体。

monsters.name: monstrous losgoroth
monsters.desc: Losgoroth are mighty void elementals, native to the void between the stars. They are rarely seen on a planet's surface.
monsters.descZh: 洛斯格罗斯是强大的虚空生物，居住于群星之间的星空中。在星球表面几乎看不到这种生物。

monsters.name: The Mouth
monsters.desc: "From bellow, it devours."
monsters.descZh: “来自深渊，吞噬四方。”

monsters.name: Subject Z
monsters.desc: This seems to be the 'subject Z' the notes spoke about. He looks human, but this cannot be -- he would be about five thousand years old!
monsters.descZh: 这个似乎是文献中提到的代号“Z”。它看起来和人类一样，但却不是人类，它至少有5000多岁了！

monsters.name: eyed tentacle
monsters.desc: A single malevolent eye is set atop this tentacle. And it watches you.
monsters.descZh: 触手上长着一只恶毒的眼睛。它正紧盯着你。

monsters.name: one hander weapons crafter
monsters.desc: This yeek has all sorts of one handed weapons to sell.
monsters.descZh: 这名夺心魔出售所有种类的单手武器。

monsters.name: blade horror
monsters.desc: Blades whirl in the air around this thin, floating figure. The air around it swirls with force, threatening to tear apart anything that approches, if the blades don't do it first.
monsters.descZh: 刀锋环绕在这只薄薄的漂浮着的恐魔周围。它周围的空气中环绕着锋利的能量，撕裂着靠近的任何东西。

monsters.name: The Teacher
monsters.desc: A being from another world, or so it claims. Despite its wholly alien appearance, it is not particularly threatening nor does it appear to be malevolent. It will not say how it learned to manipulate the powers of entropy, merely stating that it has been to many different places and experienced many different things.
monsters.descZh: 这是一位来自另一个世界的生物，起码它是这么说的。尽管它的外形十分怪异，但是它并没有表现出威胁，也没有什么恶意。他从不说出自己是怎么获得操纵熵的力量的，只是告诉你他曾经去过无数不同的地方，经历无数不同的事情。

monsters.name: rogue
monsters.desc: Stronger than a cutpurse, this thief has been promoted.
monsters.descZh: 比扒手略强，这个盗贼被训练过。

monsters.name: rogue
monsters.desc: Stealthy fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will steal your sight!
monsters.descZh: 善用诡计的潜行斗士。当心你的背后！

monsters.name: rogue sapper
monsters.desc: Stealthy tricksters that leave a wake of deadfalls and other hazards.  They really just make a mess of things.
monsters.descZh: 狡猾的骗子，他们会留下死亡陷阱和其他危险的东西。他们真的只会让事态变得糟糕。

monsters.name: Assassin Lord
monsters.desc: He is the leader of a gang of bandits; watch out for his men.
monsters.descZh: 他是一帮盗贼的头头，小心他的手下。

monsters.name: drem
monsters.desc: A small faceless humanoid with vaguely Dwarven features.  Its waraxe and shield look battered, rusted, and generally in ill repair.
monsters.descZh: 身材矮小且拥有部分矮人特征的人形怪物。它的战斧和盾牌看起来又锈又钝，几乎从未修理过。

monsters.name: drem master
monsters.desc: A disfigured humanoid with vaguely Dwarven features dressed in patched-together and rusted mail armor.  It seems to be in command of others, though its mouth is sewn shut.
monsters.descZh: 丑陋且具有部分矮人特征的人形怪物，它装备了一件破烂不堪的重甲。尽管它无法说话，但是它却领导着其他矮人。

monsters.name: drem cultist
monsters.desc: A drem cultist.
monsters.descZh: 一位德瑞姆邪教徒

monsters.name: dremling
monsters.desc: A giant black-skinned humanoid covered in spikey scabrous deposits.  Its face is featureless; its eyesockets, empty and hollow.
monsters.descZh: 皮肤粗糙且长有角质骨刺的黑色巨人。它没有明显的脸部特征，眼神空旷而呆滞。

monsters.name: drem seeker of knowledge
monsters.desc: A drem in long red robes, minding its own business.
monsters.descZh: 一位身穿红袍的德瑞姆，他正在思考自己的事情。

monsters.name: drem seeker of knowledge
monsters.desc: A drem in long red robes, minding its own business.
monsters.descZh: 一位身穿红袍的德瑞姆，他正在思考自己的事情。

monsters.name: derth guard
monsters.desc: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

monsters.name: geomancer
monsters.desc: An archmage specializing in earth magic.
monsters.descZh: 一位精通土系法术的法师。

monsters.name: emperor wight
monsters.desc: Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being approaches.
monsters.descZh: 当这只强大的不死生物靠近时，你感觉生命能量被不断地撕扯出身体。

monsters.name: electric eel
monsters.desc: A snake-like being, radiating electricity.
monsters.descZh: 一个辐射出电流的蛇形生物。

monsters.name: The Withering Thing
monsters.desc: This deformed beast might have been a wolf before, but now it is just... terrible.
monsters.descZh: 这只畸形的巨兽之前或许是头狼，不过现在……它很可怕。

monsters.name: cave troll
monsters.desc: This huge troll wields a massive spear and has a disturbingly intelligent look in its piggy eyes.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨魔手握一根笨重的长矛，同时在它那贪婪的眼睛里，你看出了一丝令人不安的信息。

monsters.name: venom drake
monsters.desc: A mature corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条成年毒龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: venom drake hatchling
monsters.desc: A corrosive venom drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
monsters.descZh: 一只毒龙幼仔。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

monsters.name: poison ivy
monsters.desc: This harmless little plant makes you all itchy.
monsters.descZh: 这棵不起眼的小植物使你全身发痒。

monsters.name: Nektosh the One-Horned
monsters.desc: A withered Whitehoof, with two horns that curve over his head and spiral into a cone.  The tip of his "horn" glows intensely, but is slowly fading; he acts confident, but his darting, wild eyes reveal panic behind them.
monsters.descZh: 一个干瘪的白蹄，他的两只角在头上弯曲成螺旋形合并起来。他头上的角发出强烈的闪光，但闪光逐渐消退。他努力让自己显得充满自信，但他飘忽不定的眼神展露出了内心的恐惧。

monsters.name: forge-giant
monsters.desc: A burning giant wielding a forge hammer of the underworld in each hand -- weapons imbued by Urh'Rok himself with the power to crush and shape felsteel. Enter their range at your peril.
monsters.descZh: 锻造巨人的每只手都有一柄地底锻造巨锤——被乌鲁洛克加持以锻造魔钢的巨锤。进入他们的领地是极度危险的事情。

monsters.name: dolleg
monsters.desc: A monstrous demon, covered in acidic thorns.
monsters.descZh: 一只畸形的恶魔，身上长有酸性尖刺。

monsters.name: dúathedlen
monsters.desc: Under a shroud of darkness you discern an evil shape.
monsters.descZh: 在黑暗之雾的笼罩下，依稀可见恶魔的形态。

monsters.name: yaech diver
monsters.desc: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.
monsters.descZh: 夺魂魔是夺心魔的一支亚种。他们拥有同样的灵能，但夺魂魔拒绝加入维网。

monsters.name: yaech hunter
monsters.desc: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.
monsters.descZh: 夺魂魔是夺心魔的一支亚种。他们拥有同样的灵能，但夺魂魔拒绝加入维网。

monsters.name: yaech psion
monsters.desc: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.
monsters.descZh: 夺魂魔是夺心魔的一支亚种。他们拥有同样的灵能，但夺魂魔拒绝加入维网。

monsters.name: Murgol, the Yaech Lord
monsters.desc: You can feel the psionic waves of power come from this yaech.
monsters.descZh: 你可以在这只夺魂魔身上感受到庞大的灵能。

monsters.name: yaech mindslayer
monsters.desc: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.
monsters.descZh: 夺魂魔是夺心魔的一支亚种。他们拥有同样的灵能，但夺魂魔拒绝加入维网。

monsters.name: yeek illusion
monsters.desc: What?!
monsters.descZh: 纳尼？！

monsters.name: Yeek Wayist
monsters.desc: This creature is about as tall as a halfling. It is covered in white silky fur and has a disproportionate head. The weirdest thing about it though, its weapon simply floats in front of it.
monsters.descZh: 这只生物像半身人一样高。他浑身被有白色的毛发并有一颗不相称的大头。最不可思议的是，他的武器就那样悬浮在他面前。

monsters.name: yeek psionic
monsters.desc: You can literaly feel the mental energies emitted by this yeek.
monsters.descZh: 你可以感受到这名夺心魔周围的能量。

monsters.name: yeek mindslayer
monsters.desc: A mindslayer in training.
monsters.descZh: 一名正在训练的夺心魔杀手。

monsters.name: Corrupted Daelach
monsters.desc: Shadow and flames. The huge beast of fire moves speedily toward you, its huge shadowy wings deployed.
monsters.descZh: 阴影和火焰。这团火焰怪物向你冲来，它的巨大暗影翅膀逐渐张开。

monsters.name: Aluin the Fallen
monsters.desc: His once-shining armour now dull and bloodstained, this Sun Paladin has given in to despair.
monsters.descZh: 他曾经闪亮的盔甲如今又锈又钝且满是鲜血，这名太阳骑士已经陷入了深深的绝望。

monsters.name: Corrupted Sand Wyrm
monsters.desc: The sandworms are gone, devoured by this shrieking, warped horror.
monsters.descZh: 沙虫们已经死了，它们被这只扭曲的恐怖所吞噬。

monsters.name: Fallen Sun Paladin Aeryn
monsters.desc: A beautiful woman, clad in shining plate armour. Power radiates from her.
monsters.descZh: 一位身披板甲的美女。她的周身闪耀着光辉。

monsters.name: Rotting Titan
monsters.desc: This gigantic mass of flesh and stone moves slowly, the ground rumbling with each step it takes. Its body seems to constantly pulsate and reform. Massive stones at the end of each limb form massive blunt weapons.
monsters.descZh: 这只行动缓慢的巨大石化怪物每走一步都会使大地为之震颤。它的身体看起来似乎在不断的颤动和重塑。厚重的石化指尖成为了它强大的钝器。

monsters.name: Malevolent Dimensional Jelly
monsters.desc: A strange black blob on the dungeon floor; through it you seem to be able to see other times and places. As you stare you see things moving out of it.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的一团黑色胶状物体。通过它的身体可以看到异次元，当你盯着它时，你发现有东西正从它身体里冒出来。

monsters.name: investigator
monsters.desc: This demon is dedicated to #{italic}#extracting#{normal}# information from #{italic}#willing#{normal}# subjects.
monsters.descZh: 这个恶魔专心于从#{italic}#志愿者#{normal}#手里#{italic}#获取#{normal}#资料。

monsters.name: mutilator
monsters.desc: A demon with 3 arms, ready to mutilate you. For experiment. Not for fun. Nope.
monsters.descZh: 一个长着三只手的恶魔，准备切割你。不是娱乐，而是实验！

monsters.name: demonic clerk
monsters.desc: A small demon, he looks alarmed at your seeming freedom.
monsters.descZh: 一个小恶魔，他对你的自由感到非常惊惶。

monsters.name: lumberjack
monsters.desc: A lumberjack. Cutting wood is his job, dream and passion.
monsters.descZh: 一名伐木工。伐木是他的工作，梦幻而激情。

monsters.name: faeros
monsters.desc: Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.
monsters.descZh: 法罗是高智商的火元素，大家很少能在火山以外的地方看到它们。也许，它们根本不属于这个世界。

monsters.name: apprentice mage
monsters.desc: An apprentice, learning the ways of the arcane arts.
monsters.descZh: 一位学徒，正在学习法术的奥秘。

monsters.name: The One That Defends
monsters.desc: This creature sells armours for the sanctuary.
monsters.descZh: 这个生物在避难所出售防具。

monsters.name: Fillarel Aldaren
monsters.desc: An Elven woman. She wears a tight robe decorated with symbols of the Sun and the Moon and wields a staff.
monsters.descZh: 一名精灵女子。她穿着日月图案的长袍，手持一根法杖。

monsters.name: Filio Flightfond
monsters.desc:
A short, furtive-looking skeleton with padded feet. He moves quickly and silently, and seems to meld into the shadows with ease. In one hand he holds a sling, and the other a short dagger.
There is a cunning air to his hollow skull, and his empty sockets reveal nothing of what tricks and tactics he has planned.
monsters.descZh:
一个矮小的猥琐骷髅，它的脚底有着一层肉垫。他迅捷而隐蔽，并且擅长融入黑暗。他的左手拿着投石索，右手则拿着一柄匕首。
他中空的头骨里有着一团灵活的空气，他空旷的眼孔中再也看不到任何的狡诈和诡计。

monsters.name: chittering spider
monsters.desc: A huge, chittering arachnid.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的肥胖蜘蛛。

monsters.name: boiling horror
monsters.desc: This frothing ball of water rages with an intense heat.
monsters.descZh: 这个充满泡沫的水球有着极高的温度。

monsters.name: faerlhing
monsters.desc: This spider seems to command the flow of mana, which pulses freely through its body.
monsters.descZh: 这只蜘蛛善于控制法力流动，它可以使法力在它体内有节奏的跳跃。

monsters.name: storm wyrm
monsters.desc: An old and powerful storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条年长且强大的风暴巨龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: Urkis, the High Tempest
monsters.desc: Lightning crackles around this middle-aged man. He radiates power.
monsters.descZh: 电弧在这名中年男子周围回绕。他正在积蓄能量。

monsters.name: tempest
monsters.desc: An archmage specializing in lightning magic.
monsters.descZh: 一位精通闪电法术的法师。

monsters.name: storm drake
monsters.desc: A mature storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条成年风暴巨龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: storm drake hatchling
monsters.desc: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
monsters.descZh: 一条幼龙。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

monsters.name: storm wyrmic
monsters.desc: A storm wyrmic aspiring to win the tournament. He comes paired with a sand wyrmic.
monsters.descZh: 一位立志赢得比赛的风龙战士。他常和一位沙龙战士一起。

monsters.name: Maltoth the Mad
monsters.desc: This wretched human seems stuck in temporal flux.
monsters.descZh: 这个可怜的人似乎在时间的洪流中被困住了。

monsters.name: ritch impaler
monsters.desc:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
monsters.descZh:
里奇是原产于远东南部干旱地区的一种巨型土著昆虫。
他们是凶残的猎食者，用锋利的爪子刺穿大部分的盔甲，将腐败的疾病注入敌人的体内。

monsters.name: Phoenix
monsters.desc: Ever burning, ever dying, ever reviving, the Phoenix swoops down upon you, seeking to share its fiery fate with you.
monsters.descZh: 无尽的燃烧，无尽的死亡，无尽的重生，这只凤凰试图将它燃烧的命运带给你。

monsters.name: Fryjia Loren
monsters.desc: A young girl with skin pale as snow. She is small, but deadly in battle, unleashing a constant barrage of ice shards.
monsters.descZh: 一位有着雪白肌肤的年轻女孩。虽然她很小，但却擅长战斗，她可以在战斗中射出密集的冰箭。

monsters.name: risen corpse
monsters.desc: A body raised through dark magic.
monsters.descZh: 一具通过黑暗魔法漂浮着的尸体

monsters.name: bloated horror
monsters.desc: A bulbous humanoid form floats here. Its bald, child-like head is disproportionately large compared to its body, and its skin is pock-marked with nasty red sores.
monsters.descZh: 这是一只有着人头的漂浮物。它的孩子似的光头大的不成比例，并且它还有着满身恶臭的脓疮。

monsters.name: runed bone giant
monsters.desc: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies, rune-etched and infused with hateful sorceries.
monsters.descZh: 像铁塔一样的生物，由数不清的骨头构成，它的骨头上布满符文和充斥着憎恨的魔法印记。

monsters.name: degenerated ogric mass
monsters.desc: This huge mass of deformed flesh was probably once an ogre, but something had gone wrong.
monsters.descZh: 这团变形的腐肉看上去曾经是某个食人魔身体器官的一部分，不过——好像出了点什么问题

monsters.name: corrupted dendritic hemospinner
monsters.desc: This strange cell can somehow connect to Eyal itself.
monsters.descZh: 这个奇怪的细胞似乎可以通过某种方法连接到埃亚尔本身。

monsters.name: corrupted mastocytic feeder
monsters.nameZh: 腐化的饲育者肥大细胞
monsters.desc: A reddish attack cell that will crawl to you to distract you while the rest of the organism attacks.
monsters.descZh: 一团红色的攻击细胞，它会爬到你的身边，在其他器官攻击你的时候分散你的注意力。

monsters.name: corrupted acidic digestor
monsters.desc: You look like nutriments.
monsters.descZh: 看来你看起来是某种营养物质。

monsters.name: corrupted protosentient globula
monsters.desc: A huge globula of protoplasma. You can feel a kind of protosentience emanating from it, and you can tell it is hungry.
monsters.descZh: 一团球状的巨大的原生质细胞。从他的身上渗出原生质，你感觉他很饥饿。

monsters.name: corrupted protoplasmic controller
monsters.nameZh: 腐化的原生质操控细胞
monsters.desc: Acid. Fire. Pain.
monsters.descZh: 酸液。火焰。痛苦。

monsters.name: corrupted plasmic disruptor
monsters.nameZh: 腐化的原生质破坏者细胞
monsters.desc: A green oozing defence cell of the Maggot.
monsters.descZh: 这团绿色的软泥是蛆虫的防御细胞

monsters.name: degenerated skeleton archer
monsters.desc: A frail skeleton; just about the only bones that aren't cracked are its arms.  It's missing a hand, but a notch has been carved into its wrist to let it pull back a bowstring regardless.
monsters.descZh: 这具破烂不堪的骨架只有一根骨头是好的：它手持长弓的手臂。尽管它缺少了一只手，不过残缺的骨骼上雕刻的凹槽刚好可以卡住弓弦拉弓上箭。

monsters.name: degenerated skeleton warrior
monsters.desc: A haphazard collection of crumbling bones, with jerky movements that remind you of a child playing with a marionette.  It only has one arm, but that's all it needs to hold a sword.
monsters.descZh: 这具仿佛是死灵法师随意收集而成的，摇摇欲坠的骨骸，生涩地从你的眼前走过，仿佛孩童手中玩弄的木偶。虽然它只有一条手臂，不过反正这对于拿一把剑也够了，对吧。

monsters.name: wretch titan
monsters.desc: Many an adventurer has encounted the wretchling. Terrible things, wretchlings. Swarming, gnashing, burning. What those adventurers don't know is that those are just the children.
monsters.descZh: 许多冒险家都遭遇过酸液树魔。相当可怕，酸液树魔们，成群出现，灼烧腐蚀。但这些冒险家们不知道，酸液树魔只是它的未成熟的孩子。

monsters.name: rotting mummy
monsters.desc: A rotting animated corpse in mummy wrappings.
monsters.descZh: 缠绕着裹尸布的腐烂尸体。

monsters.name: gaeramarth
monsters.desc: These cunning spiders terrorize those who enter the ever-growing borders of their lairs.  Those who encounter them rarely return.
monsters.descZh: 这些狡猾的蜘蛛威胁着进入它们地盘的生物。没有人能从它们这生还。

monsters.name: high gladiator
monsters.desc: Mercenaries hired by the arena for the sole purpose of entertainment. They make a living beating people up.
monsters.descZh: 只为娱乐竞技场而请的雇佣兵。他们靠娱乐群众生存。

monsters.name: High Guard Talosis
monsters.desc: This heavily armored steam giant carries a gun in each hand. The gun in his right hand is ornate and well worn.
monsters.descZh: 这个身穿重甲的蒸汽巨人双手各持一把枪，左手的枪华丽但却陈旧。

monsters.name: orc high cryomancer
monsters.desc: An orc dressed in cold blue robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
monsters.descZh: 一只身穿冰蓝色长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

monsters.name: orc grand master assassin
monsters.desc: An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.
monsters.descZh: 一个掌握刺杀和潜行的兽人刺客。

monsters.name: orc high pyromancer
monsters.desc: An orc dressed in bright red robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
monsters.descZh: 一只身穿亮红色长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

monsters.name: orc grand summoner
monsters.desc: A fierce orc attuned to the wilds.
monsters.descZh: 一个可以和自然交流的兽人。

monsters.name: High Sun-Paladin Rodmour
monsters.desc: A Human in shiny plate armour.
monsters.descZh: 一位穿着闪耀板甲的人类。

monsters.name: high slinger
monsters.desc: Ranged fighters coming to the arena looking for wealth and glory, just like you.
monsters.descZh: 前来竞技场寻求财富和荣誉的远程斗士，就像你我一样。

monsters.name: archlich
monsters.desc: Blacker than the deepest night, this cold cruel form of darkness approaches.  Long ago it laid aside its mortality, but it has not forgotten its power; rather, its malice and hate have bent this undead entity on the destruction of all things living.
monsters.descZh: 从比漆黑的夜还要深邃的黑暗中，你感受到了一股冰冷的寒意。很久以前它放弃了生命，但却没忘记力量，相反，它被怨恨和邪念所强化，这只扭曲的不死生物要毁灭所有的生者。

monsters.name: Grgglck the Devouring Darkness
monsters.nameZh: 格尔格勒克·黑暗吞噬者
monsters.desc:
A horror from the deepest pits of the earth. It looks like a huge pile of tentacles all trying to reach for you.
You can discern a huge round mouth covered in razor-sharp teeth.
monsters.descZh: 这是来自地底最深处的恐魔。看起来像是一团巨大触手，它在不断的向你靠近。你可以在它那血盆大口里看到剃刀般的牙齿。

monsters.name: Grgglck's Tentacle
monsters.desc: This is one of Grgglck's tentacles. It looks more vulnerable than the main body.
monsters.descZh: 这是格尔格勒克的一条触须。它看起来比主体更加脆弱。

monsters.name: Glacial Legion
monsters.desc: A massive, shifting, ethereal form floats in the air around an orb of frozen blood.  The air around it condenses into freezing pools on the floor beneath it.
monsters.descZh: 一个巨大的无定形态的漂浮灵魂体，它包裹在一颗冰封的血球中。冰雾从地板上冉冉升起。

monsters.name: grannor'vor
monsters.desc: A large sluglike creature that moves slowly, leaving a trail of acid in its wake.  Its head has strangely humanoid features.
monsters.descZh: 一只长的类似蛞蝓的生物，当它缓慢经过时，会留下一滩酸性的踪迹。它的头部有着奇怪的人类特征。

monsters.name: grannor'vin
monsters.desc: A large sluglike creature with the face of a man.  Shadows seem to be drawn to its massive form, and your light dims as it approaches.
monsters.descZh: 一只长有人脸的类似蛞蝓的生物。阴影似乎都被扯向了它厚重的身体，当它靠近你时，灯光似乎都模糊了。

monsters.name: gwelgoroth
monsters.desc: Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.
monsters.descZh: 格维格罗斯是强大的气系元素，它们是电闪雷鸣的化身。

monsters.name: barrow wight
monsters.desc: It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.
monsters.descZh: 它是幽灵般的梦靥。

monsters.name: The Divine Writhing Mass
monsters.desc: Once the nervous system of the Maggot, it transformed into something... else after the Maggot ate some remains of a long dead god. If severed the Godfeaster will surely wither and die.
monsters.descZh: 这曾经是巨大蛆虫的神经系统，在它吞噬了某个死去已久的古神的时候，变成了另一种可怕的存在。如果将其摧毁，所谓的噬神者也会死去。

monsters.name: boney experiment
monsters.desc: This pile of bones appears to move on its own, but it can't seem to organise itself into something dangerous.
monsters.descZh: 这团骨头试着想要自己移动起来，但是看来它好像没法把自己变成更加强大的形态。

monsters.name: Z'quikzshl the skeletal mold
monsters.desc: Steeped in fungal malevolence, this mold refused to die.  How a mold becomes a skeleton, though, is beyond you.  Are those its own bones, or the bones of hapless adventurers?
monsters.descZh: 这只野心勃勃的霉菌拒绝死亡。然而，一只霉菌如何成为骷髅超出了你的知识范畴。也许是它自己的骨头，也许是那些倒霉的冒险者的？

monsters.name: bone giant
monsters.desc: A towering creature, made from the bones of dozens of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
monsters.descZh: 像铁塔一样的生物，由数不清的骨头构成。它全身围绕着邪恶的气息。

monsters.name: bone horror
monsters.desc: The massive ribcage in the middle beats with loud, audible cracks, as many a skeletal hand protrude forth, entwining, fusing, forming long skeletal appendages to support itself, while others crumble and collapse inward. During all this, somehow, it seems they grasp for you.
monsters.descZh: 中空的胸腔里传出巨大的破碎声，似乎许多骷髅在里面，突出，缠绕，融合，形成长长的骨架来支撑它，而其他部分倒塌向内。与此同时，似乎它们都想抓住你。

monsters.name: The One That Writes
monsters.desc: Even as this creature focuses its attention on you, many of its tentacles are preoccupied with writing letters onto sheets of strange, wispy parchment. With every word it finishes, the environment around you changes its shape, objects become more defined and patches of ground appear to be more detailed. You don't want to know the ending it has planned for your story.
monsters.descZh: 尽管它注意到了你，它的众多触须仍然继续专注地在一张奇怪的纤细羊皮纸上书写着文字。随着它的书写，你周围的一切都在发生着变化，身边的物体和地面变得更加清晰。你可不想让他决定你人生故事的结尾。

monsters.name: The One That Writes
monsters.desc: A strange creature sporting 7 formless tentacles each with some kind of pen attached. It is ever focused on its book and does not seem to notice you, yet you can feel its hatred and hostility towards you.
monsters.descZh: 尽管它注意到了你，它的众多触须仍然继续专注地在一张奇怪的纤细羊皮纸上书写着文字。随着它的书写，你周围的一切都在发生着变化，身边的物体和地面变得更加清晰。你可不想让他决定你人生故事的结尾。

monsters.name: Star Gazer
monsters.desc: This astromancer radiates the power of all celestial bodies. You can discern a distinct elven shape under the hood and robes.
monsters.descZh: 这个星术师放射着天体的强大能量。你可以在飞舞的长袍下面前辨认出精灵的身形。

monsters.name: spectator
monsters.desc: A spectator, who probably paid a lot to watch this bloody "game".
monsters.descZh: 一名观众，他可能为了看这场血腥的“游戏”花了很多钱。

monsters.name: wisp
monsters.desc: A floating orb of magical energy. It shines with a radiant light. They explode upon contact.
monsters.descZh: 一个充满了魔法能量的球体。它散发着耀眼的光芒，当它们接触其他物体时会发生爆炸。

monsters.name: Harkor'Zun
monsters.desc: A gigantic demon composed of elemental Earth, resembling a twisted Xaren but much, much larger.  It doesn't seem pleased with your presence.
monsters.descZh: 一个由土元素构成的巨大恶魔，它长的像一只被放大且扭曲过的钻石土元素。似乎你的到来使它很不高兴。

monsters.name: The Fragmented Essence of Harkor'Zun
monsters.desc: Fragmented essence... maybe it'd be best if it stayed fragmented.
monsters.descZh: 精华碎片……如果它仍然呈碎裂状态就好了。

monsters.name: Admiral Korbek
monsters.desc: This old troll stands tall and proud in somewhat ornate clothing; it's clear he is an important figure. He holds in his right hand a wicked looking blade, and in his left hand what seems to be an antique handgun.
monsters.descZh: 这只年长的巨魔昂首挺胸，身穿华丽的服装；不用说，他一定是一个重要人物。它右手持一把邪恶长剑，左手拿着一把古色古香的手枪。

monsters.name: blue crystal
monsters.desc: A formation of blue crystal. Its light shines like the ocean's waves.
monsters.descZh: 一个由蓝色水晶构成的生物，它通体荡漾着海蓝色的光芒。

monsters.name: Forest Troll Hedge-Wizard
monsters.desc: This old-looking troll glares at you with malice. His muscles appear atrophied, but a certain power surrounds him nonetheless.
monsters.descZh: 这只老迈的巨魔恶狠狠的盯着你。尽管它已经年老力衰，但是你仍能感受到一股强大的能量环绕着它。

monsters.name: giant ice ant
monsters.desc: It's a large white ant. The air is frigid around it.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的白色蚂蚁，它四周的空气都凝固了。

monsters.name: The Conjointed
monsters.desc: This creature sells tools for the sanctuary.
monsters.descZh: 这个生物在避难所出售工具。

monsters.name: umber hulk
monsters.desc: This bizarre creature has glaring eyes and large mandibles capable of slicing through rock.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨大的生物有着铜铃般的眼睛和一个能够咬断岩石的上颚。

monsters.name: hethugoroth
monsters.desc: A swirling mass of hot vapour animated into a semblance of life.
monsters.descZh: 一个灼热的蒸汽漩涡所形成的生命体。

monsters.name: panther
monsters.desc: A large black cat, slender and muscular.
monsters.descZh: 一只体型匀称的黑豹。

monsters.name: black jelly
monsters.desc: A strange black blob on the dungeon floor.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的一团黑色胶状物体。

monsters.name: black mamba
monsters.desc: It has glistening black skin, a sleek body, and highly venomous fangs.
monsters.descZh: 它有着光滑的黑色皮肤，节状的身体和锋利的毒牙。

monsters.name: black ooze
monsters.desc: It's black and it's oozing.
monsters.descZh: 又黑又粘的软泥怪。

monsters.name: giant black ant
monsters.desc: It's a large black ant.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的黑色蚂蚁。

monsters.name: black crystal
monsters.desc: A formation of black crystal. It absorbs all light around it.
monsters.descZh: 一个由黑色水晶构成的生物，它可以吸收周围的光芒，黑暗笼着着它。

monsters.name: black bear
monsters.desc: Do you smell like honey? 'Cause this bear wants honey.
monsters.descZh: 你闻起来有蜂蜜味吗？这只熊喜欢蜂蜜哦～

monsters.name: shadow of hate
monsters.desc: A shadowy embodiment of hate.
monsters.descZh: 一团由恨意具现成的阴影。

monsters.name: red jelly
monsters.desc: A strange red blob on the dungeon floor.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的一团红色胶状物体。

monsters.name: red ooze
monsters.desc: It's red and it's oozing.
monsters.descZh: 又红又粘的软泥怪。

monsters.name: giant red ant
monsters.desc: It's a large red ant.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的红色蚂蚁。

monsters.name: red crystal
monsters.desc: A formation of red crystal. It emits bright red, scorching light.
monsters.descZh: 一个由红色水晶构成的生物，它散发着耀眼的红色光芒。

monsters.name: chitinous ritch
monsters.desc:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
monsters.descZh:
里奇是原产于远东南部干旱地区的一种巨型土著昆虫。
他们是凶残的猎食者，用锋利的爪子刺穿大部分的盔甲，将腐败的疾病注入敌人的体内。

monsters.name: fox
monsters.desc: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
monsters.descZh: 这只灵巧的棕色狐狸从一只懒狗身上跳了过去。

monsters.name: hornet swarm
monsters.desc: You have intruded on their ground, and they will defend it at all costs.
monsters.descZh: 你已经闯入了它们的地盘，它们会不择手段的攻击你。

monsters.name: yellow jelly
monsters.desc: A strange yellow blob on the dungeon floor.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的一团黄色胶状物体。

monsters.name: yellow ooze
monsters.desc: It's yellow and it's oozing.
monsters.descZh: 又黄又粘的软泥怪。

monsters.name: giant yellow ant
monsters.desc: It's a large yellow ant.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的黄色蚂蚁。

monsters.name: grey mold
monsters.desc: A strange grey growth on the dungeon floor.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的奇特灰色植物。

monsters.name: grizzly bear
monsters.desc: A huge, beastly bear, more savage than most of its kind.
monsters.descZh: 一头巨大野蛮的熊，它比同类们更加凶残。

monsters.name: shadow of remorse
monsters.desc: A shadowy embodiment of remorse.
monsters.descZh: 一团由悔恨具现成的阴影。

monsters.name: ruin banshee
monsters.desc: A vengeful, screaming soul given form with the breath of Urh'Rok himself. The vapors of the Fearscape seep from its dimension-bending form, withering and searing.
monsters.descZh: 乌鲁洛克的吐息中诞生，不断嚎叫的复仇之魂。恐惧之地的气息不断从她次元扭曲的身体中渗出，不断灼烧和腐蚀着周围的一切。

monsters.name: Golbug the Destroyer
monsters.desc: A huge and muscular orc of unknown breed. He looks both menacing and cunning...
monsters.descZh: 一只膘肥身健的巨大兽人。他看起来既危险又狡猾……

monsters.name: animated blood
monsters.desc: This crimson shape drips ceaselessly, spattering the nearby ground. The droplets seem to continue moving of their own volition.
monsters.descZh: 血红色的物体不断滴落液体，散落在地面上。滴落下来的血液似乎有着自己的意志。

monsters.name: fire drake
monsters.desc: A mature fire drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条成年火龙，拥有炽烈的火焰吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: fire drake hatchling
monsters.desc: A drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
monsters.descZh: 一条幼龙。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

monsters.name: fire imp
monsters.desc: A small demon, lobbing spells at you.
monsters.descZh: 一只小恶魔，它向你发射法术。

monsters.name: fire wyrm
monsters.desc: An old and powerful fire drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条年长且强大的火龙，拥有炽烈的火焰吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: giant fire ant
monsters.desc: It's a large red ant, wreathed in flames.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的红色蚂蚁，全身燃烧着火焰。

monsters.name: ritch flamespitter
monsters.desc:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
monsters.descZh:
里奇是原产于远东南部干旱地区的一种巨型土著昆虫。
他们是凶残的猎食者，用锋利的爪子刺穿大部分的盔甲，将腐败的疾病注入敌人的体内。

monsters.name: mecharachnid destroyer
monsters.desc: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. An armed to the teeth, well, mandibles, spider.
monsters.descZh: 这是个看上去很像蜘蛛的八腿机械构造体。一个武装到牙齿，呃，颚部的蜘蛛。

monsters.name: mecharachnid flame thrower
monsters.desc: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. The huge flame thrower mounted on its back however is definitively un-spider-like.
monsters.descZh: 这是个看上去很像蜘蛛的八腿机械构造体。尽管蜘蛛可不会有它背后装载的巨型火焰喷射器。

monsters.name: mecharachnid repairbot
monsters.desc: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. It seems to be more concerned by its fellow arachnids than by you.
monsters.descZh: 这是个看上去很像蜘蛛的八腿机械构造体。比起你，它似乎更关心它的同胞们。

monsters.name: mecharachnid warrior
monsters.desc: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. A huge clonking spider that runs to you at great speed ready to cut you to pieces with its two rotating saws in place of mandibles.
monsters.descZh: 这是个看上去很像蜘蛛的八腿机械构造体。它正向你飞速冲来并准备用颚部的旋转锯刃将你撕成碎片。

monsters.name: Lady Nashva the Streambender
monsters.nameZh: 激流盘旋者纳纱瓦女士
monsters.desc: Water circles slowly on the ground around this naga's tail. Her dark tail is coiled tight, making her look short, but her calm and confident stare assure you that she will not be easily overcome. As the water begins to rise around her the air starts to shimmer, and you feel her dark eyes are penetrating into you deeper than is comfortable.
monsters.descZh: 水流缓慢的围绕着这位娜迦的尾巴旋转。她黑色的尾巴蜷缩起来，使她看起来较为矮小，但是她沉着而自信的脸庞使你感受到她无所畏惧。当水流在她周围蒸腾时，星空都仿佛失去了光芒，你感到她的眼神看穿了你的内心。

monsters.name: Distorted Animated Sword
monsters.desc: This floating weapon shifts and shimmers, time and space warping and bending as it moves. It appears to vibrate, as if it may explode at any moment.
monsters.descZh: 时空在其周围崩塌。

monsters.name: The Spinal Cord
monsters.desc: One of the centers of the nervous system of the Maggot, if severed the Maggot will surely wither and die.
monsters.descZh: 巨大蛆虫的神经中枢。如果将其摧毁，巨大蛆虫也会死去。

monsters.name: Lone Wolf
monsters.desc: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, only 3 times bigger than a normal wolf. It looks hungry. You look tasty!
monsters.descZh: 这是一只狡诈的狼，只有普通狼的3倍大。它看起来很饥渴，而你——很美味！

monsters.name: Lone Wolf
monsters.desc: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, only 3 times bigger than a normal wolf. It looks hungry. You look tasty!
monsters.descZh: 这是一只狡诈的狼，只有普通狼的3倍大。它看起来很饥渴，而你——很美味！

monsters.name: parasitic horror
monsters.desc: You don't want to think about what sort of creature this lamprey-like horror was feeding on to grow so large.  Its skin pulsates and writhes, like things are moving underneath...
monsters.descZh: 你不想知道这个像七鳃鳗一样的恐魔是吃什么才能长这么大的。它的皮肤不停的扭动，就像有东西在下面移动一样...

monsters.name: spiked tentacle
monsters.desc: A huge tentacle, ready to crush you with its many spikes.
monsters.descZh: 一个巨大的触手，准备用他的尖刺粉碎你。

monsters.name: sabertooth tiger
monsters.desc: This cat is simply enormous, and has fangs with the size and sharpness of short swords.
monsters.descZh: 这只凶残的老虎有着短剑般大小的锋利牙齿。

monsters.name: ghoulish rat
monsters.desc: Layers of rotting skin are peeling off of this rat. One of the eye sockets appears empty.
monsters.descZh: 斑驳的皮肤从这只老鼠身上脱落，它的一只眼窝空洞的看着你。

monsters.name: gladiator
monsters.desc: Mercenaries hired by the arena for the sole purpose of entertainment. They make a living beating people up.
monsters.descZh: 只为娱乐竞技场而请的雇佣兵。他们靠娱乐群众生存。

monsters.name: gladiator
monsters.desc: A menacing man in heavy armor, wielding a mace. He looks battle-hardened.
monsters.descZh: 只为娱乐竞技场而请的雇佣兵。他们靠娱乐群众生存。

monsters.name: luminous horror
monsters.desc: A lanky humanoid shape composed of yellow light.
monsters.descZh: 一只身材瘦长的怪物，它的身体由金色的光芒组成。

monsters.name: golden crystal
monsters.desc: A formation of golden crystal. It emits a golden radiance equalling the sun itself.
monsters.descZh: 一块金色的水晶体。它向外辐射出像太阳一样的光芒。

monsters.name: giant army ant
monsters.desc: It's a large ant with a heavy exoskeleton, geared for war.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的蚂蚁，有厚重的用于战斗的外壳。

monsters.name: Crystallized Primal Root
monsters.desc: This once great primal tree has been infused and corrupted by crystals growing wildly all over it. Such a terrible end.
monsters.descZh: 这个曾经伟大的原始树木，已经被疯狂蔓延的水晶侵蚀注入和腐化。真是可怕的结局。

monsters.name: crystalbark
monsters.desc: A very strong near-sentient tree, which has become infected with crystalline structures.
monsters.descZh: 一个强大的有智能的树精，现在已经被晶体结构所侵蚀。

monsters.name: elven corruptor
monsters.desc: An elven corruptor, drawn to these blighted lands.
monsters.descZh: 一位精灵堕落者，生存于不毛之地上。

monsters.name: elven mage
monsters.desc: An elven mage, dressed in dark robes.
monsters.descZh: 一位身穿黑色长袍的精灵法师。

monsters.name: elven tempest
monsters.desc: An elven mage, dressed in crackling blue robes, and smelling of ozone.
monsters.descZh: 一位身穿散发着死鱼味蓝色长袍的精灵法师。

monsters.name: shalore rune master
monsters.desc: A tall Elf, his skin covered in runes.
monsters.descZh: 一名高大的精灵，他的皮肤刻上了各种纹身。

monsters.name: elven archer
monsters.desc: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

monsters.name: thalore hunter
monsters.desc: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

monsters.name: elven guard
monsters.desc: An elven guard.
monsters.descZh: 一位精灵守卫。

monsters.name: elven sun-mage
monsters.desc: An elf dressed in glowing robes.
monsters.descZh: 一位穿着鲜艳长袍的精灵。

monsters.name: elven cultist
monsters.desc: An elven cultist, dressed in sickening green robes.
monsters.descZh: 一位身穿墨绿色长袍的精灵信徒。

monsters.name: elven astromancer
monsters.desc: A mage who has studied all there is to know about the stars and their working.
monsters.descZh: 一个将毕生精力投入到了对星辰及其原理的学习中的法师。

monsters.name: elven blood mage
monsters.desc: An elven blood mage, dressing in dark, bloodied robes.
monsters.descZh: 一位身穿黑色且鲜血斑斑长袍的精灵血法师。

monsters.name: elven warrior
monsters.desc: An elven warrior, clad in heavy armour.
monsters.descZh: 一位身穿重甲的精灵战士。

monsters.name: thalore wilder
monsters.desc: A tall elf, his skin covered in green moss.
monsters.descZh: 一名高大的精灵，他的皮肤覆有青苔。

monsters.name: thalore wilder
monsters.desc: A tall elf, his skin covered in green moss.
monsters.descZh: 一名高大的精灵，他的皮肤覆有青苔。

monsters.name: elven elite warrior
monsters.desc: An elven warrior, clad in heavy armour.
monsters.descZh: 一位身穿重甲的精灵战士。

monsters.name: Briagh, Great Sand Wyrm
monsters.desc: A towering sand drake stands before you. This wingless worm is mighty and could easily crush you.
monsters.descZh: 一只铁塔般的沙龙战士站在你面前。这只陆行龙非常强大且可以轻易撕碎你。

monsters.name: orc elite fighter
monsters.desc: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a shield and a deadly axe.
monsters.descZh: 一只身穿板甲的兽人，装备有一面盾牌和一个致命的斧头。

monsters.name: orc elite berserker
monsters.desc: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a huge axe.
monsters.descZh: 一只身穿板甲的兽人，手里握着一把巨斧。

monsters.name: ultimate faeros
monsters.desc: Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.
monsters.descZh: 法罗是高智商的火元素，大家很少能在火山以外的地方看到它们。也许，它们根本不属于这个世界。

monsters.name: ultimate gwelgoroth
monsters.desc: Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.
monsters.descZh: 格维格罗斯是强大的气系元素，它们是电闪雷鸣的化身。

monsters.name: ultimate shivgoroth
monsters.desc: Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.
monsters.descZh: 西弗格罗斯是强大的寒冰元素，它们被一股强大的魔法从老家里赶出来

monsters.name: whitehoof maulotaur
monsters.desc: This big undead minotaur is carrying a nasty looking hammer, imbued with lightning.
monsters.descZh: 这个巨大的亡灵牛头人拿着一把灌注了闪电的可怕巨锤。

monsters.name: giant venus flytrap
monsters.desc: This flesh-eating plant has grown to enormous proportions and seeks to quell its hunger.
monsters.descZh: 这棵巨大的肉食性植物正在寻找果腹的东西。

monsters.name: gigantic corrosive tunneler
monsters.desc: This huge worm burrows through the earth using its powerful corrosive saliva.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨大的沙虫使用它腐蚀性的唾液挖掘泥土。

monsters.name: gigantic sandworm tunneler
monsters.desc: The ground shakes as this huge worm burrows towards you, its gigantic mouth just as capable of devouring flesh as stone.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨大的沙虫挖地道靠近你时，大地在震颤。它的巨口似乎能吞下和石头一样硬的猎物。

monsters.name: giant crystal rat
monsters.desc: Instead of fur, this rat has crystals growing on its back, which provide extra protection.
monsters.descZh: 与普通耗子不同，这只耗子背上长着晶化皮毛，它因此获得了额外的保护。

monsters.name: giant rabbit
monsters.desc: Kill the wabbit, kill the wabbit, kill the wabbbbbiiiiiit.
monsters.descZh: 快去打小白兔，哼哼哈嘿；快去打小白兔，哼哼哈嘿；吾辈就是要去，打小白兔……

monsters.name: giant rabbit
monsters.desc: Kill the wabbit, kill the wabbit, kill the wabbbbbiiiiiit.
monsters.descZh: 快去打小白兔，哼哼哈嘿；快去打小白兔，哼哼哈嘿；吾辈就是要去，打小白兔……

monsters.name: giant netherworm
monsters.desc: A disgusting mass of distorted worms, slithering towards you.
monsters.descZh: 一团令人厌恶的扭曲蠕虫，正在向你爬行过来。

monsters.name: gigantic gravity worm
monsters.desc: Space and time seem to bend around this huge worm.
monsters.descZh: 这只沙虫似乎扭曲了周围的时空。

monsters.name: great wolf
monsters.desc: Larger than a normal wolf, it prowls and snaps at you.
monsters.descZh: 当你行走在路上时，这只巨狼突然从草丛里跳出来扑向了你。

monsters.name: Rantha the Worm
monsters.desc: Claws and teeth. Ice and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
monsters.descZh: 尖牙利齿，冰冷致命。似乎龙族并没有完全灭绝……

monsters.name: Varsha the Writhing
monsters.desc: Claws and teeth. Fire and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
monsters.descZh: 尖牙利齿，火焰致命。似乎龙族并没有灭绝……

monsters.name: anaconda
monsters.desc: You recoil in fear as you notice this gigantic snake.  It seeks to crush the life out of you.
monsters.descZh: 当你看到这只10米长的庞然巨物时，本能的后退了一步。它在寻找突袭你的机会。

monsters.name: troll captain
monsters.desc: This troll is barking orders to the other trolls around him. He effortlessly holds a longsword in each hand.
monsters.descZh: 这个巨魔正在咆哮着地对他身旁的巨魔下达命令。他毫不费力的双手各拿着一柄长剑。

monsters.name: troll pirate
monsters.desc: This is a Troll pirate.
monsters.descZh: 这是一个巨魔海盗。

monsters.name: troll aquamancer
monsters.desc: This troll is holding a tall staff in one hand. Tendrils of water circle around it.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨魔一只手拿着一柄长杖。他的身边盘绕着由水组成的触手。

monsters.name: troll marauder
monsters.desc: This lean but muscular troll deftly wields two daggers. He glares at you with eyes filled with cunning.
monsters.descZh: 这个精壮的巨魔熟练使用着一对匕首。他看向你的目光中满是狡诈。

monsters.name: troll guard
monsters.desc: This troll carries a large sword and shield, and appears to be wearing segments of armor.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨魔拿着巨大的剑盾，身上穿了一些零碎的护甲。

monsters.name: entrenched horror
monsters.desc: This massive stony structure shifts and pulsates, its many long, thin tentacles probing the nearby water for food.
monsters.descZh: 这个巨大的石状生物有规律的震动着，它的触手为了水和食物正在四处游走探测。

monsters.name: large white snake
monsters.desc: This large snake hisses at you, angry at being disturbed.
monsters.descZh: 这只蛇向你发出嘶嘶声，你的闯入使它很生气。

monsters.name: giant alligator
monsters.desc: How cliche! Also, terrifying!
monsters.descZh: 多么的老套，并且可怕！

monsters.name: gigantic bone rat
monsters.desc: This massive beast appears to be a rat composed of countless bones fused together.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨大的怪物看起来像是许多骨头拼起来的老鼠。

monsters.name: giant eel
monsters.desc: A snake-like being, moving toward you.
monsters.descZh: 像蛇一样的生物，径直朝你游来。

monsters.name: greater mummy
monsters.desc: An animated corpse in mummy wrappings, both very well preserved.
monsters.descZh: 一具缠绕着裹尸布的鲜活尸体，保存得很好。

monsters.name: Greater Mummy Lord
monsters.desc: The wrappings of this mummy radiate with so much power it feels like wind is blowing from them.
monsters.descZh: 这只木乃伊身上所缠绕的裹尸布散发着巨大的能量，似乎它的能量改变了空气的流动。

monsters.name: huge sandworm burrower
monsters.desc:
This sandworm seems to not care about your presence at all and simply continues digging its way through the sand.
	
Maybe following it is the only way to move around here...
monsters.descZh: 这只沙虫似乎毫不在意你的出现，只顾埋头挖掘。也许跟着它才能找到出路。

monsters.name: Orc Greatmother
monsters.desc:
This giant, bloated form towers above you. Mucus and slime ooze from every orifice, dripping onto the cavern floor. Orc children fight over the right to feed from her distended teats whilst small babies are regularly emerge from folds of flesh. The sight and the smell make you retch.
Here stands a tremendous form almost the size of a dragon. Bloated skin rises in thick folds, seeping viscous slime from its wide pores. Hundreds of hanging teats feed a small army of squabbling, fighting young orcs - only the toughest of them are able to gain the precious nutrients to grow stronger, the weaker ones left to wither on the mouldy floor. At the top of this towering hulk is a shrivelled head coated in long tangled hair. Dazed eyes peer out with a mixture of sadness and pain, but as they fix on you they turn to anger, the creature's face contorted with the fierce desire to protect its young.
monsters.descZh: 站在我们面前的是一只跟龙差不多体型的怪物。皮肤下鼓起了无数浮肿的肉块，粗大的毛孔里不断流淌出粘稠的液体。上百个乳头喂养了一批互相争吵打斗的兽人——只有最强壮的才能获得补充营养的优先权，弱小的只能在地上等待死亡。数十个生殖器在不断的抽动，不时的挤出新的兽人。在这只怪物的头顶是一头蓬乱长发的枯萎面容，茫然的眼神中混合着些许悲伤和痛苦。但是当她看到你时，她变的异常愤怒，她愤怒的面孔里透露着她护子的决心。

monsters.name: giant spider
monsters.desc: A huge arachnid, it produces even bigger webs.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的蛛形纲动物，它可以织出更大的网。

monsters.name: giant spider
monsters.desc: A huge arachnid.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的蛛形纲生物。

monsters.name: large brown snake
monsters.desc: This large snake hisses at you, angry at being disturbed.
monsters.descZh: 这只蛇向你发出嘶嘶声，你的闯入使它很生气。

monsters.name: poison ooze
monsters.desc: It's very slimy and it's oozing.
monsters.descZh: 粘糊糊的软泥怪。

monsters.name: Sawtree
monsters.desc:
#{italic}##ANTIQUE_WHITE#Is that... a tree that cuts down trees?
Oh no don't worry. Only adventurers!#LAST##{normal}#
monsters.descZh:
#{italic}##ANTIQUE_WHITE#这是一颗…在砍树的树吗？
哦，不用担心。这只是冒险家！#LAST##{normal}#

monsters.name: Kor's Fury
monsters.desc: The Shade's colossal will keeps it anchored to this world, now as a vengeful, insane spirit.
monsters.descZh: 暗影骷髅使用强大的能量使它存留于世。现在，它成为了疯狂的复仇之魂。

monsters.name: Kryl-Feijan
monsters.desc: This huge demon is covered in darkness. The ripped flesh of its "mother" still hangs from its sharp claws.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨大的恶魔被黑暗所包围。它的“母亲”的碎肉仍悬挂在它的利爪上。

monsters.name: Acolyte of the Sect of Kryl-Feijan
monsters.desc: Black-robed Elves with a mad look in their eyes.
monsters.descZh: 穿着黑色长袍的精灵，他们的眼中满是疯狂。

monsters.name: Caldizar
monsters.desc: A creature stands before you, with long tentacle-like appendages and a squat bump in place of a head. An intense aura of power radiates from this being unlike anything you've ever felt before. It can only be a Sher'Tul. A living Sher'Tul!
monsters.descZh: 四肢是触须，头部由某种突起代替的奇怪生物。一种强烈的能量在他周围流动，这股能量不同于你之前认识的任何一种。他只能是夏·图尔人。一名活生生的夏·图尔人！

monsters.name: Caldizar
monsters.desc: A creature stands before you, with long tentacle-like appendages and a squat bump in place of a head. An intense aura of power radiates from this being unlike anything you've ever felt before. It can only be a Sher'Tul. A living Sher'Tul!
monsters.descZh: 四肢是触须，头部由某种突起代替的奇怪生物。一种强烈的能量在他周围流动，这股能量不同于你之前认识的任何一种。他只能是夏·图尔人。一名活生生的夏·图尔人！

monsters.name: cute little bunny
monsters.desc: It looks at you with cute little eyes before jumping at you with razor sharp teeth.
monsters.descZh: 它用无辜的眼神看着你，同时用剃刀般锋利的牙齿扑向你。

monsters.name: Kyless
monsters.desc: This is Kyless, your old friend. He seems dirtier than you recall and a good bit more dangerous.
monsters.descZh: 这是克里斯，你的老朋友。他比你的记忆中更加蓬头垢面，也更加危险。

monsters.name: Chronolith Clone
monsters.desc: A six-armed creature, dressed in robes, with black insectile eyes.
monsters.descZh: 身穿长袍、有着昆虫样复眼的六臂生物。

monsters.name: Krogar
monsters.desc: An orc clad in mail armour, he wields a staff and looks menacing.
monsters.descZh: 一名穿着锁甲的兽人，他手持法杖并且看起来凶残异常。

monsters.name: Planar Controller
monsters.desc: A huge demon towers above you, it is obviously in control of all the portals in the nearby Fearscape area.
monsters.descZh: 一个巨大的恶魔朝你走来，显然他控制着附近所有的传送门。

monsters.name: Healer Astelrid
monsters.nameZh: 孔克雷夫治疗师亚斯特莉
monsters.desc: An enormous ogre, clad in a tattered set of robes with an officer's badge.  She clutches a healer's staff, wrapped in casting plaster and scalpels for use as a massive spiked club.
monsters.descZh: 一个巨大的食人魔，身上穿着的破烂长袍上是一枚亮闪闪的官员徽章。她用手抓住一把治疗用的法杖，被石膏浇铸并裹挟着手术刀，用作一个巨大的狼牙棒。

monsters.name: fearful symmetry
monsters.desc: A strange vortex of malevolent triangles.
monsters.descZh: 一团三角图形组成的充满恶意的漩涡。

monsters.name: skeleton assassin
monsters.desc: Most skeletons announce their presence with a chorus of rattling bones; this one's been charred black and has enough cartilage between its joints to muffle its approach.  The first you'll see of it will be the flash of its blade.
monsters.descZh: 普通骷髅骨节之间的吱嘎猛响会早早暴露他们的行踪，但这只骷髅的身躯被烧焦成暗夜的黑色，关节间的软骨缓冲着骨节的转动。当你看到它时，它银光闪耀的刀刃已经出现在你的眼前。

monsters.name: skeleton mage
monsters.desc: Given its condition, you're less inclined to think this skeleton knows proper spells, rather than simply disgorging its magical energy as it breaks down.  This doesn't make it much less dangerous to be around, mind you.
monsters.descZh: 看着它残破的样子，你与其相信这只骷髅会释放魔法，不如相信是在它身躯逐渐破碎的同时将奥术能量胡乱喷射出来。不过，这一点也没有降低它的危险性，小心。

monsters.name: skeleton archer
monsters.desc: Nobody scavenged the high-quality bow from this archer before it was raised from the dead.  You're about to wish the world had more grave-robbers.
monsters.descZh: 在被复活之前，这位弓箭手的遗体上居然还保留着一张还不错的弓。你开始觉得，世界上如果有更多的盗墓贼就好了。

monsters.name: skeleton master archer
monsters.desc: This skeleton can fire arrows and nock new ones with blinding speed.  Arcane forces pull its bones with unnatural precision - its arms will never tremble or get tired.
monsters.descZh: 这只骷髅可以飞速的拈弓射箭，奥术的力量使它的身躯达到了常人无法企及的精确度——它的射击永远不会颤动，也永远不会疲累。

monsters.name: skeleton magus
monsters.desc: This skeleton has been imbued with far more magical energy than normal, and serves as a conduit of its master's spellcasting prowess.
monsters.descZh: 这只骷髅的身上充盈着更加丰沛的魔法力量，作为它的主人强大魔力的明证。

monsters.name: skeletal rat
monsters.desc: A skeletal rat, teeth and claws ground to a sharp point. It glares at you menacingly.
monsters.descZh: 一只骨瘦如柴的老鼠，牙齿和爪子磨得很尖。它充满威胁地瞪着你。

monsters.name: skeletal rat
monsters.desc: The diminutive skeleton of a giant rat, charged with evil energies. Nobody understands the usefulness of undead rodents until several of them come after you.
monsters.descZh: 一只被邪恶能量支配的巨大老鼠骨骼。在它们追赶你之前，没人知道亡灵啮齿动物的可怕。

monsters.name: skeleton warrior
monsters.desc: The forces binding this skeleton together are resilient enough to let it hold a shield and swing a weapon as well as it could have in life.  It's still wearing its old armor, in rusty but servicable condition.
monsters.descZh: 施展在这只骷髅身上的魔法已经足够灵活，足以让它像还活着的时候那样严阵以待，挥动武器。它仍然穿着它原来的那件老盔甲，锈迹斑斑却值得信赖。

monsters.name: Khulmanar, General of Urh'Rok
monsters.nameZh: 库马纳·乌鲁洛克之近卫将军
monsters.desc: This massive form, sheathed in dark flames, stands tall above a legion of lesser demons. In his hands he holds a massive blackened battleaxe, flames dancing around the blades.
monsters.descZh: 这个庞大的躯体笼罩在黑暗之炎中，他在一群小恶魔中显得鹤立鸡群。在他手里握着一柄沉重的双手斧，火焰在刀锋处舞动。

monsters.name: quasit
monsters.desc: A small, heavily armoured demon, rushing toward you.
monsters.descZh: 一只装备了重甲的小恶魔，它向你发起冲锋。

monsters.name: quasit squad leader
monsters.desc: A small, heavily armoured demon, rushing toward you.
monsters.descZh: 一只装备了重甲的小恶魔，它向你发起冲锋。

monsters.name: dire wolf
monsters.desc: Easily as big as a horse, this wolf menaces you with its claws and fangs.
monsters.descZh: 这头狼几乎和一匹马一样大，它的尖牙利齿令人望而生畏。

monsters.name: Wrathroot
monsters.desc: The ancient grey willow tree, ruler of the Old Forest. He despises trespassers in his territory.
monsters.descZh: 这颗远古的柳树统治着整个古老树林。他蔑视一切闯入者。

monsters.name: golem
monsters.desc: This golem's eyes glow with magical energies.
monsters.descZh: 这个傀儡的眼睛闪烁着魔法的能量。

monsters.name: Atamathon the Giant Golem
monsters.desc: This giant golem was constructed by the Halflings during the Pyre Wars to fight the orcs, but was felled by Garkul the Devourer. Someone foolish has tried to reconstruct it, but has lost control of it, and now it rampages in search of its original creators, who are long dead. Its body is made of marble, its joints of solid voratun, and its eyes of purest ruby. At over 40 feet tall, it towers above you, and its crimson orbs seem to glow with rage.
monsters.descZh: 这只巨大的傀儡是半身人在派尔纪对抗兽人时所造，但是被吞噬者加库尔摧毁。有些笨蛋试图重修它，但是控制核心已经丢失，现在它在疯狂的寻找它的制造者——某个死了无数年的家伙。它的躯体由花岗岩制成，它的关节由沃瑞钽制成，它的眼睛则是纯净的红宝石。它有着40英尺高，像铁塔般站在你面前，它闪亮的红宝石眼睛似乎散发着怒意。

monsters.name: Rak'Shor Cultist
monsters.desc: An old orc, wearing black robes. He seems to be responsible for the creation of the shades.
monsters.descZh: 一只穿着黑色长袍的老兽人。看起来他就是阴影的缔造者。

monsters.name: Rantha the Abomination
monsters.desc: Claws and teeth. Ice and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...  and this one seems to have been corrupted by the time rift.
monsters.descZh: 尖牙利齿，冰冷致命。似乎龙族并没有完全灭绝……并且这只似乎被时空能量所扭曲。

monsters.name: blue jelly
monsters.desc: A strange blue blob on the dungeon floor.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的一团蓝色胶状物体。

monsters.name: blue ooze
monsters.desc: It's blue and it's oozing.
monsters.descZh: 又蓝又粘的软泥怪。

monsters.name: giant blue ant
monsters.desc: It's a large blue ant.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的蓝色蚂蚁。

monsters.name: wolf
monsters.desc: Lean, mean, and shaggy, it stares at you with hungry eyes.
monsters.descZh: 一头瘦弱的、狡猾的皮毛蓬松的饿狼，它正用贪婪的眼神看着你。

monsters.name: tiger
monsters.desc: A truly magnificent beast, with fur striped black and yellow.
monsters.descZh: 一只真正的肉食动物，它有着黄黑相间的毛皮。

monsters.name: ritch centipede
monsters.desc: This strange creature looks like a ritch hunter but with more legs. So many legs.
monsters.descZh: 这个奇怪的生物看上去像是一个里奇猎手，但是它的脚要多多了，多很多很多。

monsters.name: ritch hive mother
monsters.desc:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
monsters.descZh:
里奇是原产于远东南部干旱地区的一种巨型土著昆虫。
他们是凶残的猎食者，用锋利的爪子刺穿大部分的盔甲，将腐败的疾病注入敌人的体内。

monsters.name: Ritch Great Hive Mother
monsters.desc: This huge ritch seems to be the mother of all those here. Her sharp, fiery, claws dart toward you!
monsters.descZh: 这只巨大的里奇似乎是所有里奇的母亲。她锋利的爪子向你扑来！
