monsters.name: Lithfengel
monsters.desc: A terrible demon of decay and atrophy, drawn to the energy of the farportal. A beast of blight!
monsters.descZh: 一只缠绕着枯萎和衰竭的可怕恶魔，他被传送门的能量吸引而来。这只瘟神！

monsters.name: Riala Shalarak
monsters.desc: A strong female magician. Years of experience make her a dangerous combatant.
monsters.descZh: 一位强大的女法师。多年的经验使她成为非常致命的决斗者。

monsters.name: That Which Teaches History
monsters.desc: This creature manages the sanctuary's library.
monsters.descZh: 这个生物掌管着避难所的图书馆。

monsters.name: alchemist golem
monsters.desc: This golem's eyes glow with magical energies.
monsters.descZh: 这个傀儡的眼睛闪烁着魔法的能量。

monsters.name: master alchemist
monsters.desc: Deadly fighters using explosive gems to attack.
monsters.descZh: 使用宝石进行攻击的致命斗士。

monsters.name: alchemist
monsters.desc: Deadly fighters using explosive gems to attack.
monsters.descZh: 使用宝石进行攻击的致命斗士。

monsters.name: saw horror
monsters.desc: Oh. Oh no. Where did it get those?
monsters.descZh: 哦。哦不。它是怎么弄到这些的？

monsters.name: pyromancer
monsters.desc: An archmage specializing in fire magic.
monsters.descZh: 一位精通火焰法术的法师。

monsters.name: war dog
monsters.desc: This is a large dog, bred and trained for fighting.
monsters.descZh: 这是一条老练的猎犬，被培育和训练用于战斗。

monsters.name: ninurlhing
monsters.desc: The air reeks with noxious fumes and the ground around it decays.
monsters.descZh: 在它周围，毒雾散播，大地枯萎。

monsters.name: maelstrom
monsters.desc: This powerful vortex of ice and lightning somehow gives you the impression of claws, teeth and intense hunger...
monsters.descZh: 这个强大的灵能漩涡莫名其妙地给你一种利齿尖牙和饥饿的印象...

monsters.name: guardian psi-ghost
monsters.desc: A strangely humanoid shaped-ghost, blurring in and out of existence as its form is shaken by psionic discharges.
monsters.descZh: 一个奇怪的人形幽灵，它的身形忽闪忽现，似乎是被某种灵能所启动。

monsters.name: The Master
monsters.desc: A terrifying vampiric figure of power, with flowing robes and an intense aura of fright.  His cold, sinewy flesh seems to cling to this world through greed and malice, and his eyes betray a strength of mind beyond any puny mortal.  All nearby are utterly subservient to his will, though he stands aloof from them, as if to say he needs not the pathetic meddling of minions to help him overcome his foes.  Your eyes are drawn to a dark staff in his hands which seems to suck the very life from the air around it.  It looks ancient and dangerous and terrible, and the sight of it fills you with fervent desire.
monsters.descZh: 一个拥有强大力量的可怕吸血鬼，他的长袍无风自动，周身环绕着恐惧光环。他冰冷而强壮的肉体似乎在向世界宣告着贪婪和怨恨，他的眼神透露着一股睥睨天下的自信。周围的不死族都完全服从于他，尽管如此，他还是表现出厌恶的神情，就好像他不需要这些废物来御敌一样。你的目光被他手里的黑色法杖所吸引，这根法杖似乎在不断的吸取周围的活力。它看起来古老而可怕，看到它的瞬间，你心底的欲望被彻底点燃了。

monsters.name: dragon turtle
monsters.desc: A huge, elongated sea-green reptile.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大、细长且泛着海蓝色的爬行动物。

monsters.name: losselhing
monsters.desc: The air seems to freeze solid around this frigid spider.
monsters.descZh: 这只寒冷的蜘蛛似乎使周围的空气都凝固了。

monsters.name: green jelly
monsters.desc: A strange green blob on the dungeon floor.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的一团绿色胶状物体。

monsters.name: green ooze
monsters.desc: It's green and it's oozing.
monsters.descZh: 又绿又粘的软泥怪。

monsters.name: giant green ant
monsters.desc: It's a large green ant.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的绿色蚂蚁。

monsters.name: green mold
monsters.desc: A strange sickly green growth on the dungeon floor.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的奇特绿色植物。

monsters.name: Rogroth, Eater of Souls
monsters.desc: Fire and blight arcane surges randomly appear on this spider-like dark metallic skin. There are no definite head but a single huge mouth onto its body.
monsters.descZh: 火焰和枯萎的力量在蜘蛛一样的黑色金属皮肤上闪现。它没有明显的头部，只有一个大大的嘴巴。

monsters.name: Rhaloren Inquisitor
monsters.desc: This tall elf rushes at you, wielding both her greatsword and magical spells.
monsters.descZh: 这位高大的精灵冲向你，同时带来她锋利的大剑和魔法的怒吼。

monsters.name: spire dragon
monsters.desc: A monstrous, coiled wyrm, patient and hateful. Its hide, studded with spikes and crests and blades, turns aside steel and sorcery with equal ease.
monsters.descZh: 一只奇特的、盘绕的巨龙，它可憎却沉稳。它的表皮上布满了倒刺和利刃，可以轻松抵挡金属武器攻击和魔法能量。

monsters.name: losgoroth
monsters.desc: Losgoroth are mighty void elementals, native to the void between the stars. They are rarely seen on a planet's surface.
monsters.descZh: 洛斯格罗斯是强大的虚空生物，居住于群星之间的星空中。在星球表面几乎看不到这种生物。

monsters.name: Malyu
monsters.desc: This gritty adventurer saved you.
monsters.descZh: 这个勇敢的冒险家救了你。

monsters.name: maulotaur
monsters.desc: A belligerent minotaur with a destructive magical arsenal, and armed with a hammer.
monsters.descZh: 好战的米诺陶，装备有一柄巨锤且拥有强力的魔法。

monsters.name: Metash the Maulotaur
monsters.desc: This big undead minotaur is carrying a nasty looking hammer, imbued with lightning.
monsters.descZh: 这个巨大的亡灵牛头人拿着一把灌注了闪电的可怕巨锤。

monsters.name: larvae bloated ritch mother
monsters.desc: The skin of this creature is literally crawling with larvae, yet she seems to be moving toward you very fast.
monsters.descZh: 这个生物的皮肤上爬满了幼虫，字面意义上的爬满。尽管如此，她向你前进的速度非常快。

monsters.name: The Sightless Acolyte
monsters.desc: This creature sells weapons for the sanctuary.
monsters.descZh: 这个生物在避难所出售武器。

monsters.name: hairy spider
monsters.desc: A huge, hairy arachnid.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的毛蜘蛛。

monsters.name: Melinda
monsters.desc: A female Human with twisted sigils scored into her naked flesh. Her wrists and ankles are sore and hurt by ropes and chains. You can discern great beauty beyond the stains of blood covering her skin.
monsters.descZh: 一位赤裸并且全身刻有扭曲符文的女人。她的四肢被镣铐绑在了祭台上。尽管她的皮肤上满是鲜血，你仍然能发现她的美丽。

monsters.name: Melinda
monsters.desc: Enjoying a lovely day at the beach.
monsters.descZh: 在海滩上度过美好的一天。

monsters.name: venom wyrm
monsters.desc: An old and powerful corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条年长且强大的毒龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: dreaming horror
monsters.desc:
A vaguely tentacled yet constantly changing form rests here apparently oblivious to your existence.
With each slow breath it takes reality distorts around it.  Blue twirls into red, green twists into yellow, and the air sings softly before bursting into a myriad of pastel shapes and colors.
monsters.descZh:
这是一只混沌状的触手生物，它在这里惬意的休息并不断的变幻着颜色，显然无视了你的存在。
它的每次呼吸都会使周围的空间发生轻微的扭曲。在它身上氤氲着的光芒由蓝转红、由绿转黄，交织成一片五彩缤纷的和谐幻景。

monsters.name: The Dreaming One
monsters.desc: This strange globe of blue light seems to be alive and asleep. Nothing about it moves, yet you can feel the crushing power of its dreams assaulting your mind.
monsters.descZh: 这个奇怪的发光球体似乎是活的，而且正在熟睡。不过，尽管它还没有移动，你已经感受到它梦境的力量在冲击自己的精神。

monsters.name: dream seed
monsters.desc: A pinkish bubble floats here, reflecting the world not as it is, but as it would be in that surreal place that exists only in our dreams.
monsters.descZh: 这是一个漂浮着的粉红色泡沫，它似乎能够反映出世界的另一面，但是由于这虚幻的空间，它所反映的事物只可能存在于我们的梦境中。

monsters.name: dread
monsters.desc: It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate, its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe itself strives to banish it.
monsters.descZh: 它的可怕形象冲击着你的双眼。它是死亡的化身，它丑恶的身体似乎在向宇宙宣告着它与现实的格格不入。

monsters.name: nightmare horror
monsters.desc: A shifting form of darkest night that seems to reflect your deepest fears.
monsters.descZh: 一只漆黑的生物，它深邃的黑色身体反射出了你深深的恐惧。

monsters.name: dreadmaster
monsters.desc: It is an unlife of power almost unequaled. An affront to existence, its very touch abuses and disrupts the flow of life, and its unearthly limbs, of purest black, crumble rock and wither flesh with ease.
monsters.descZh: 它代表着无可匹敌的非生命力量。是对现实存在的否定。对它的轻微接触都会影响生命的流动，它那纯粹的不可思议的黑色边缘能够轻松地使岩石崩解，血肉成灰。

monsters.name: Minotaur of the Labyrinth
monsters.desc: A fearsome bull-headed monster, he swings a mighty axe as he curses all who defy him.
monsters.descZh: 一只可怕的牛头怪，它挥舞着巨斧毁灭前方的一切。

monsters.name: lost wife
monsters.desc: Your wife has been turned into a giant, bloated form that towers above you. Mucus and slime ooze from every orifice, dripping onto the floor. The sight and the smell make you retch.
monsters.descZh: 你的妻子变成了一只铁塔般的浮肿怪物。囊肿和粘糊糊的液体从每个毛孔向外溢出，不断的滴落在地板上。此情此景使你异常反胃。

monsters.name: minotaur
monsters.desc: It is a cross between a human and a bull.
monsters.descZh: 它拥有人类和牛的特征。

monsters.name: minotaur mindscrew
monsters.desc: A belligerent minotaur with a frightening amount of mind powers, and armed with a hammer and a pack of huge rocks.
monsters.descZh: 这个好战的米诺陶有着强大的精神力量。他一手拿着锤子，一手拿着巨大的石块。

monsters.name: bee swarm
monsters.desc: They buzz at you threateningly, as you have gotten too close to their hive.
monsters.descZh: 它们向你发出嗡嗡的警告声，因为你离它们的巢穴太近了。

monsters.name: honey tree
monsters.desc: As you approach it, you hear a high-pitched buzzing sound.
monsters.descZh: 当你靠近它时，你听到一阵刺耳的嗡嗡声。

monsters.name: fate weaver
monsters.desc: A large white spider.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的白色蜘蛛。

monsters.name: fate spinner
monsters.desc: Easily as big as a horse, this giant spider menaces at you with claws and fangs.
monsters.descZh: 像一只马一样大的蜘蛛，它的尖牙利齿已经饥渴难耐了。

monsters.name: Archmage Tarelion
monsters.desc: A tall Shalore in a flowing robe, he looks calm and at peace, but you can feel his tremendous power.
monsters.descZh: 一位穿着光滑长袍的高大永恒精灵，他看起来很稳重，你可以感受到他体内蕴含的强大能量。

monsters.name: Spellblaze Simulacrum
monsters.desc: A formation of purple crystal, but where the others could only be described as polyhedral, this construct seems to strangely resemble... you, if you were much, much larger.
monsters.descZh: 一种紫色水晶，如果其他水晶可以被定义为多面体的话，那么这个水晶只能说……和你一样，如果你大个几倍的话。

monsters.name: Spellblaze Crystal
monsters.desc: A formation of purple crystal. It seems strangely aware.
monsters.descZh: 一种紫色水晶。它有着奇特的意识。

monsters.name: manaworm
monsters.desc: Manaworms are losgoroth which feed on the mana of arcane users. If they ever come in contact with a spellcaster, they latch on and start draining mana away.
monsters.descZh: 魔法蠕虫是以施法者的魔力为食的虚空生物。如果它们近距离接触到法师，它们会缠上去并吸干对方的魔力。

monsters.name: some merchant
monsters.desc: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

monsters.name: grave wight
monsters.desc: It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.
monsters.descZh: 它呈幽灵形态，眼睛一直盯着你。

monsters.name: naga tidecaller
monsters.desc: A slithering noise accompanies the movement of this strange creature, whose snake-like tail gives rise to the body of a beautiful elf-like woman. As she moves her delicate hands water rises from the ground, and you feel that here is no mere monster, but a creature of awe and power.
monsters.descZh: 在这只奇怪的生物爬行时伴随着摩擦的噪声，像蛇一样的尾巴却支撑着美丽动人的躯体。当她游动时，她将面前的水抬向大地，你感到面前的不是怪物，而是令人敬畏的力量。

monsters.name: naga tidecaller
monsters.desc: A slithering noise accompanies the movement of this strange creature, whose snake-like tail gives rise to the body of a beautiful Elf-like woman. As she moves her delicate hands, water rises from the ground, and you feel that here is no mere monster, but a creature of awe and power.
monsters.descZh: 在这只奇怪的生物爬行时伴随着摩擦的噪声，像蛇一样的尾巴却支撑着美丽动人的躯体。当她游动时，她将面前的水抬向大地，你感到面前的不是怪物，而是令人敬畏的力量。

monsters.name: naga tide huntress
monsters.desc: Though the sharp point of an arrow pointed steadily at your head is of concern, more unnerving is the creature that wields it: a slim and lithe woman from the waist up, but a terrifying giant serpent beneath, her tail stretching for several feet behind her. Her eyes turn cold and ice seems to magically condense on the tip of her barbed arrow. Suddenly it is of concern again.
monsters.descZh: 尽管那根指向你的锋利箭矢是令人恐惧的，但是更加令人恐惧的是使用它的生物。一个身材姣好，杨柳细腰的女人，身后却拖了一条数英尺的尾巴。她的眼睛变的冰冷，似乎有魔力凝聚在她那锋利的箭矢上。突然间，你又感到箭矢的恐怖了。

monsters.name: naga tidewarden
monsters.desc: Before you stands a tall figure, propped high by a serpent's tail in place of where his legs should rightly be. His torso is slim and muscular, and his face has an elven beauty to it, framed by locks of blonde hair. But there is a fierceness to this creature too, and his bright eyes veil a smouldering anger.
monsters.descZh: 在你的面前站着一位高大的生物，在他的腿部是像蛇一样的尾巴。他的身躯看起来高大威猛，并且他还有着一张精灵般美貌的脸庞和一头秀丽的长发。但同样的，这个生物也异常危险，你可以从他的眼睛中看到潜藏的愤怒。

monsters.name: naga nereid
monsters.desc: Green eyes stare out from behind strands of long, golden hair, which falls down in waves over smooth, pale skin. Your eyes are drawn to the bare flesh, but as they look further they see dark scales stretching out into a long serpent's tail. You look up as she moves, her hair parting to reveal a slim and beautiful face with high cheekbones and full lips. Yet for all the allure of this wondrous creature the terror of the serpentine tail sends shivers down your spine.
monsters.descZh: 绿色的眼睛后面是披落在白皙肩膀的金发。你的眼睛被裸露的肌肤所吸引，但是当你往下看时，你会发现黑色的长蛇尾巴。当她移动时你看向她的脸部，在金发之下是红润而美丽的脸庞，有着高颧骨和丰满的嘴唇。虽然从各方面看来，她都很完美，但是仍掩饰不住你眼皮底下的蛇尾巴带来的恐怖。

monsters.name: naga nereid
monsters.desc: Green eyes stare out from behind strands of long, golden hair, which falls down in waves over smooth, pale skin. Your eyes are drawn to the bare flesh, but as they look further they see dark scales stretching out into a long serpent's tail. You look up as she moves, her hair parting to reveal a slim and beautiful face with high cheekbones and full lips. Yet for all the allure of this wondrous creature the terror of the serpentine tail sends shivers down your spine.
monsters.descZh: 绿色的眼睛后面是披落在白皙肩膀的金发。你的眼睛被裸露的肌肤所吸引，但是当你往下看时，你会发现黑色的长蛇尾巴。当她移动时你看向她的脸部，在金发之下是红润而美丽的脸庞，有着高颧骨和丰满的嘴唇。虽然从各方面看来，她都很完美，但是仍掩饰不住你眼皮底下的蛇尾巴带来的恐怖。

monsters.name: naga psyren
monsters.desc: Such a mix of enchanting beauty and revolting horror you have never before seen combined. Above, a beautiful, ethereal woman, of scant form and entrancing grace. Below, the thick, smooth scales of a snake, its stretched tail gently waving back and forth in the air behind her. The movement is eye-catching and hypnotic, and whilst you watch a mysterious smile plays across her seductive lips.
monsters.descZh: 你从未见过如此妖娆和恐怖的结合。上半身是一个美丽而出尘，性感而又迷人的女人。下半身是厚实而光滑的蛇尾。尾巴在她身后缓慢的来回摆动着，摆动的幅度醒目而又具有迷惑性。当你抬头看她时，你看到她性感的嘴角漾起神秘的微笑。

monsters.name: naga myrmidon
monsters.desc: Before you stands a tall figure -- a very tall figure, propped high by a thick serpent's tail in place of where his legs should rightly be. His torso is human-like, with bulging muscles beneath fitted armour, and large hands gripping a fiercely sharp trident. He glares at you with dark intensity, like a wolf about to pounce on unsuspecting prey.
monsters.descZh: 在你面前站着一个高大的人影——一个非常高的人型怪物，在腿部长着巨大的蛇尾巴，他以此来支撑他的身体。他的上半身是人形,护甲下面隐约可见发达的肌肉，两只巨大的双手紧握着锋利的三叉戟。他用黑暗视觉盯着你，就像一只狼一样，随时准备扑向毫无防备的猎物。

monsters.name: Ninandra, the Great Weaver
monsters.desc: A huge blue and white spiderkin whose form shifts and shimmers in and out of reality.  She spins the threads of fate and binds the destiny of all within her web.
monsters.descZh: 一只不断移动和闪烁于相位现实间的巨大蜘蛛，身上有着蓝黄相间的花纹。她可以编制命运之网并将猎物的命运捆绑在网上。

monsters.name: Nimisil
monsters.desc: Covered by eerie luminescent growths and protuberances, this spider now haunts the maze's silent passageways.
monsters.descZh: 这只蜘蛛覆盖着可怕的发光物和瘤状物，挡住了迷宫的空旷过道。

monsters.name: slimy crawler
monsters.desc:
This disgusting... thing crawls on the floor toward you with great speed.
It seems to come from the digestive system of the mouth.
monsters.descZh:
这只恶心的……东西在地板上迅速的向你爬来。
似乎它是由某个消化系统中的嘴部演化而来。

monsters.name: young orc
monsters.desc: This young orc is almost fully formed, with hard muscles prominently visible beneath its thick skin. Whilst it has lost some of the wild energy of its younger siblings you can see the gleams of intelligence and cold calculation behind its dark eyes.
monsters.descZh: 这只兽人已经快成年了，它的皮肤下有着强壮的肌肉。虽然由于狂暴能量的影响它失去了许多兄弟姐妹，但你仍可以从他的眼中发现一闪而过的智慧和狡诈。

monsters.name: oozing horror
monsters.desc: A massive, amorphous blob of green slime crawls on the ground towards you. Eyes drift through the viscous mass, scanning for potential prey.
monsters.descZh: 一个巨大的有着绿色斑点的黏糊糊的物体从地上爬过来。在一堆黏糊糊中隐藏着的眼睛，寻找着潜藏的猎物。

monsters.name: Chanting Necromancer
monsters.desc: A grim looking necromancer vampire. It seems to be draining the krogs of their life force for some nefarious purpose.
monsters.descZh: 一个冷酷的吸血鬼死灵法师。他似乎正在吸取克罗格的生命能量来用于某种邪恶的目的。

monsters.name: giant carpenter ant
monsters.desc: It's a large black ant with huge mandibles.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的黑色蚂蚁，有巨大的下颚。

monsters.name: Borfast the Broken
monsters.desc:
Thick skin hangs loosely from this short, shambling form. Tufts of hair sticking out from its chin give evidence of a once magnificent dwarven beard. Half its face seems to have been seared in acid at some point, the flesh melted away from the skull and an eyeball drooping low from its socket. There is a unique sadness to its eyes, and a slump of resignation to its gait.
What proud hero of renown was this before he was condemned to such a terrible fate?
monsters.descZh: 在你面前的是一只步履蹒跚、肌肉松弛的——怪物。从他下巴中伸出的浓密胡须以及他的毛发来看，这是一位矮人。看起来他的半边脸曾经被硫酸泼过，血肉从他的脸部脱落，其中一只眼睛从它的眼窝中掉了出来。他的独眼有一种莫名的悲伤，透露着深深的无奈。如此威风的英雄人物怎会落得如此下场？

monsters.name: slave combatant
monsters.desc: This humanoid has been enslaved by the yaech's mental powers.
monsters.descZh: 这个人类已经被夺魂魔心灵控制。

monsters.name: slaver
monsters.desc: A slaver.
monsters.descZh: 一名奴隶商。

monsters.name: shadow of anger
monsters.desc: A shadowy embodiment of anger.
monsters.descZh: 一团由愤怒具现成的阴影。

monsters.name: Norgan
monsters.desc: Norgan and you are the sole survivors of the Reknor expedition; your duty is to make sure the news makes it back to the Iron Council.
monsters.descZh: 诺尔甘和你都是瑞库纳探险队的幸存者，你的任务是把消息带回钢铁议会。

monsters.name: onilug
monsters.desc:
A gaunt vaguely humanoid shape featuring unadorned grey leathery skin. Its arms and legs seem somehow too long and it stands tall, projecting an ominous shadow even in darkness.
Its glowing red eyes shine with both cruelty and a deep frightening intellect.
monsters.descZh:
一个憔悴而模糊不清的人形生物，全身是未经修饰的灰色皮肤。不知为何，它的胳膊和腿很长。当它耸立在那里的时候，即使在黑暗中也会投下不祥的阴影。
它发光的红色眼睛闪烁着，目光里蕴含着既残酷又深邃可怕的智慧。

monsters.name: The Crawler
monsters.desc: This creature sells staves and wands for the sanctuary.
monsters.descZh: 这个生物在避难所出售法杖。

monsters.name: gargantuan sher'tan
monsters.desc: This abomination has the height of any other titan but its feature definitively remind you of the few Sher'Tul images you have seen. Your very being rebels to the thought and sheer terror takes hold of your mind.
monsters.descZh: 这个孽物和其他泰坦差不多高，但是他的特征让你回想起了你见过的那些夏·图尔人图片。你竭尽全力的抗拒这些想法，你的心灵已被纯粹的恐惧所控制。

monsters.name: ink squid
monsters.desc: Darting its many tentacles toward you, it tries to blind you with its murky ink.
monsters.descZh: 它向你伸出能变形的魔爪，并使用黑色的墨汁喷向你，使你失明。

monsters.name: Robe-clad elf
monsters.desc: An elf that looks as though he spends a good amount of his time wiggling his fingers and chanting.
monsters.descZh: 这名精灵看起来一生都花费在了手势和颂歌中。

monsters.name: tanner
monsters.desc: This yeek has all sorts of leathers to sell.
monsters.descZh: 这名夺心魔出售所有种类的皮革。

monsters.name: broken golem
monsters.desc: This golem is badly damaged.
monsters.descZh: 这个傀儡遭受过严重的破坏。

monsters.name: Vor, Grand Geomancer of the Pride
monsters.nameZh: 普莱德地卜师将军沃尔
monsters.desc: An old orc, wearing multi-colored robes. Ice shards fly around him, leaving a trail of fire and lightning bursts.
monsters.descZh: 一名身穿彩色长袍的年老兽人。冰霜在他周围盘旋，他在走过的路上留下一条雷火之径。

monsters.name: Gorbat, Supreme Wyrmic of the Pride
monsters.nameZh: 普莱德龙战士领主加伯特
monsters.desc: An orc with scaly skin, claws and a pair of small wings on his back.
monsters.descZh: 一只皮肤上布有鳞片的兽人，他的背后有着锋利的爪子和一对翅膀。

monsters.name: Rak'shor, Grand Necromancer of the Pride
monsters.nameZh: 普莱德死灵魔导师拉克·肖
monsters.desc: An old orc, wearing black robes. He commands his undead armies to destroy you.
monsters.descZh: 一只穿着黑色长袍的年老兽人。他命令不死大军攻击你。

monsters.name: Grushnak, Battlemaster of the Pride
monsters.nameZh: 普莱德战争领主格鲁希纳克
monsters.desc: An old orc, covered in battle scars, he looks fierce and very, very, dangerous.
monsters.descZh: 一只浑身都是伤疤的年老兽人，他看起来异常的凶残和危险。

monsters.name: multi-hued drake
monsters.desc: A mature multi-hued drake, armed with many deadly breath weapons and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条成年七彩龙，拥有许多致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: multi-hued drake hatchling
monsters.desc: A drake hatchling. Not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
monsters.descZh: 一条幼龙。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

monsters.name: multihued wyrmic
monsters.desc: A powerful wyrmic with mastery over several elements.
monsters.descZh: 一位精通数种元素的强大龙战士。

monsters.name: Ureslak the Prismatic
monsters.desc: A huge multi-hued drake. It seems to shift color rapidly.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的七彩龙。它似乎在快速的变幻颜色。

monsters.name: trickster
monsters.desc: Stealthy ranged fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will shoot your heart!
monsters.descZh: 善用诡计的潜行远程斗士。小心他们射穿你的心脏！

monsters.name: Outpost Leader John
monsters.desc: This warrior's armor glows with a bright golden light. He wields an ornate sword and shield, and marches towards you with confidence.
monsters.descZh: 这位战士的盔甲闪耀着璀璨的金光。他挥动华丽的剑与盾，自信地向你冲来。

monsters.name: Gunsnake
monsters.desc: #{italic}##ANTIQUE_WHITE#From a bygone era it slithers...#LAST##{normal}#
monsters.descZh: #{italic}##ANTIQUE_WHITE#从某个过去的时代滑行而来……#LAST##{normal}#

monsters.name: bandit
monsters.desc: These ruffians often employ brute force over thievery, but they are capable of stealing as well.
monsters.descZh: 这些恶棍通常在行窃过程中施以暴行，同时他们也很擅长隐匿。

monsters.name: bandit lord
monsters.desc: He is the leader of a gang of bandits. Watch out for his underlings.
monsters.descZh: 他是这伙强盗的首领，当心他的手下。

monsters.name: greater faeros
monsters.desc: Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.
monsters.descZh: 法罗是高智商的火元素，大家很少能在火山以外的地方看到它们。也许，它们根本不属于这个世界。

monsters.name: greater gwelgoroth
monsters.desc: Gwelgoroth are mighty air elementals, a pure incarnation of lightning and thunder.
monsters.descZh: 格维格罗斯是强大的气系元素，它们是电闪雷鸣的化身。

monsters.name: greater multi-hued wyrm
monsters.desc: An old and powerful multi-hued drake, armed with many deadly breath weapons and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条年长且强大的七彩龙，拥有许多致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: greater shivgoroth
monsters.desc: Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.
monsters.descZh: 西弗格罗斯是强大的寒冰元素，它们被一股强大的魔法从老家里赶出来

monsters.name: giant acid ant
monsters.desc: It's a large black ant.  Its porous skin oozes acid.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的黑色蚂蚁，皮肤渗透出酸液。

monsters.name: orb weaver
monsters.desc: A large brownish arachnid spinning its web.  It doesn't look pleased that you've disturbed its work.
monsters.descZh: 一只正在结网的巨大褐色蜘蛛，你的打扰使它很不高兴。

monsters.name: orb spinner
monsters.desc: A large brownish arachnid, its fangs drip with a strange fluid.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的褐色蜘蛛，它的尖牙不断的滴落奇怪的液体。

monsters.name: swarming horror
monsters.desc: This tiny fish-like creature moves erratically, but is constantly surrounded by others of its kind.
monsters.descZh: 体型小的、象鱼一样的怪物，总是成群出现。

monsters.name: human farmer
monsters.desc: A weather-worn Human farmer.
monsters.descZh: 穿着普通的人类农民。

monsters.name: human citizen
monsters.desc: A clean-looking Human resident of Last Hope.
monsters.descZh: 一位面容清秀的最后希望市民。

monsters.name: human guard
monsters.desc: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

monsters.name: human sun-paladin
monsters.desc: A human in shiny plate armour.
monsters.descZh: 一位穿着闪耀板甲的人类。

monsters.name: human sun-paladin
monsters.desc: A Human in shiny plate armour.
monsters.descZh: 一位穿着闪耀板甲的人类。

monsters.name: human student
monsters.desc: A human student.
monsters.descZh: 一个人类学徒

monsters.name: The Amalgamation
monsters.desc: Creating a living being from scratch is not an easy process. There are plenty of things which can go wrong, including multiple eyes, surplus limbs, too few brains and multiple bodies being fused into a single, raging mass of flesh and bone. Despite how bulky the creature is, it moves with supple ease, quickly closing the gap between you and it.
monsters.descZh: 从零开始创造一个生物并不是一件容易的事情。有很多地方可能出错，比如多了点眼睛，多了点四肢，少了点脑子，或者把无数躯体融合成这样一团血肉和骨骸组成的，蠕动着的巨大怪物。尽管这个生物体型庞大，它仍然可以轻快地移动，很快缩小了和你之间的距离

monsters.name: worm that walks
monsters.desc:
A bulging rotten robe seems to tear at the seams, with masses of bloated worms spilling out all around the moving form.  Two arm-like appendages, each made up of overlapping mucous-drenched maggots, grasp tightly around the handles of bile-coated waraxes.
Each swing drips pustulant fluid before it, and each droplet writhes and wriggles in the air before splashing against the ground.
monsters.descZh: 一件鼓鼓囊囊的长袍，长袍的缝隙里不断蠕动着浮肿的蠕虫。它有着两只臂膀一样的附属物，每只手都由重叠的蠕虫组成，各握着一柄覆有胆汁的斧子。每次挥舞武器的时，它都会溅出尸僵毒液，每滴毒液在落到地面前都在沸腾和翻滚着。

monsters.name: animated mummy wrappings
monsters.desc: An animated set of mummy wrappings, without a corpse inside; it seems like it cannot move.
monsters.descZh: 一条蠕动的木乃伊裹尸布，里面没有尸体……它看起来无法移动。

monsters.name: Ryal
monsters.desc: A gargantuan bone giant resembling a wingless wyrm. He is fully sentient and surprisingly fast.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的骨头巨兽，它的前身似乎是一只地行龙。它有着敏锐的意识和惊人的速度。

monsters.name: Rej Arkatis
monsters.desc: A Cornac fighter of respectable talent. He emerged from nowhere and became the true master of fighting.
monsters.descZh: 一位有着优秀战技的科纳克人斗士。他来历不明却成为了战斗大师。

monsters.name: Slasul
monsters.desc: This towering naga exudes power, and radiates a certain charismatic charm as well. His masculine face stares at you with great intensity, and you struggle to meet his gaze. His torso is bare apart from an exquisite pearl set directly in his chest, and in his muscular arms he holds ready a heavy mace and shield. You sense there is more to him also, as if the very power of the ocean were concentrated in this great creature, and that the wrath of it may come flooding out at any moment.
monsters.descZh: 这只铁塔般的娜迦散发着强大的能量，并拥有一张英俊潇洒的脸庞。他刚毅的面容紧张的盯着你，尽管你试图逃避他的凝视。他的上身赤裸，只有一串珍珠挂在胸前，他强壮的臂膀分别握着一把巨锤和一面盾牌。你发现这里似乎是他的主场，好像整个海洋的能量都集中在了这位娜迦身上，海洋之怒似乎会随时向你涌来。

monsters.name: Celia
monsters.desc: A tall woman stands before you in a stained robe. Her sallow skin is marked by pox and open sores, but her eyes are bright and keen. The bulge around her abdomen would indicate that she is several months pregnant.
monsters.descZh: 一位穿着肮脏长袍的高瘦女人。她灰色的皮肤上满是疮痕，但她的眼睛清澈明亮。她肚子上的反映出她至少有几个月的身孕了。

monsters.name: forest troll
monsters.desc: Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
monsters.descZh: 丑陋的绿皮生物正盯着你，同时它握紧了满是肉瘤的绿色拳头。

monsters.name: forest wight
monsters.desc: It is a ghostly apparition with a humanoid form.
monsters.descZh: 它有着人类的脸孔，幽灵般的影子。

monsters.name: sandworm
monsters.desc: A huge worm coloured as the sand it inhabits. It seems quite unhappy about you being in its lair.
monsters.descZh: 一只伪装成沙子颜色的巨大沙虫。它很不高兴你闯入它的地盘。

monsters.name: sandworm destroyer
monsters.desc: A huge worm coloured as the sand it inhabits. This particular sandworm seems to have been bred for one purpose only: the eradication of everything that is non-sandworm, such as... you.
monsters.descZh: 一只伪装成沙子颜色的巨大沙虫。这只特殊的沙虫生来只有一个目标：消灭所有非沙虫的异类，比如……你。

monsters.name: Sandworm Queen
monsters.desc: Before you stands the queen of the sandworms. Massive and bloated, she slithers toward you, calling for her offspring!
monsters.descZh: 在你面前站着的是沙虫女皇。她带着厚重的甲壳和肥胖的身体向你冲来，同时她还在召唤子孙！

monsters.name: sandworm burrower
monsters.desc:
This sandworm seems to not care about your presence at all and simply continues digging its way through the sand.
	
Maybe following it is the only way to move around here...
monsters.descZh: 这只沙虫似乎毫不在意你的出现，只顾埋头挖掘。也许跟着它才能找到出路。

monsters.name: sand-drake
monsters.desc: This unholy creature looks like a wingless dragon in shape, but it is sand-colored, making it all the more dangerous for its prey.
monsters.descZh: 这只邪恶的生物从体型上看更像一只短翼龙，并且和沙虫一样伪装自己。

monsters.name: sand wyrmic
monsters.desc: A sand wyrmic aspiring to win the tournament. He comes paired with a storm wyrmic.
monsters.descZh: 一位立志赢得比赛的沙龙战士。他常和一位风龙战士一起。

monsters.name: mountain troll
monsters.desc: A large and athletic troll with an extremely tough and warty hide.
monsters.descZh: 一只高大且强壮的巨魔，身披一张丑陋但异常坚硬的兽皮。

monsters.name: giant lightning ant
monsters.desc: It's a large yellow ant with sparks arcing across its body.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的黄色蚂蚁，身体闪耀着电火花。

monsters.name: mountain troll thunderer
monsters.desc: A large and athletic troll with an extremely tough and warty hide.
monsters.descZh: 一只高大且强壮的巨魔，身披一张丑陋但异常坚硬的兽皮。

monsters.name: snow giant thunderer
monsters.desc: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly. Lightning crackles over its body.
monsters.descZh: 一只酷似人类却很高大的生物。它手握一个巨锤，看起来不是很友好。闪电在它周身流动。

monsters.name: shining mold
monsters.desc: A strange luminescent growth on the dungeon floor.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的奇特闪光植物。

monsters.name: shimmering crystal
monsters.desc: A formation of shimmering crystal. Orbs of light circle around it.
monsters.descZh: 一个由闪光水晶构成的生物，它通体围绕着球状的光芒。

monsters.name: caravan porter
monsters.desc: A caravan porter.
monsters.descZh: 一个商队里的搬运工

monsters.name: caravan merchant
monsters.desc: A caravan merchant.
monsters.descZh: 一个商队里的商人

monsters.name: caravan guard
monsters.desc: A caravan guard.
monsters.descZh: 一个商队里的守卫

monsters.name: Hypostasis of Entropy
monsters.desc: The twisting mass of limbs and maws that floats in front of you is no less than inevitability personified. All civilisation, all life, all matter, all energy and all light will one day succumb to entropy. You feel terribly cold as a horrifying realisation comes to the forefront of your mind. The heat death of the universe itself is coming for you.
monsters.descZh: 扭曲的躯体张开巨口，在你的眼前浮现。所有的文明，所有的生命，所有的物质，所有的光芒终究会屈服在熵的面前。恐惧让你感到冰冷，你意识到了这一最可怕的可能性。宇宙热寂的本质即将吞噬你。

monsters.name: basaligator
monsters.desc: This thing looks like an alligator, but it has unnaturally large, grey eyes. It gazes at you with great intensity.
monsters.descZh: 这个东西看上去像是只鳄鱼，但是它有一双大的不自然的灰色眼睛。它正在紧紧的盯着你。

monsters.name: crimson ooze
monsters.desc: It's reddish and it's oozing.
monsters.descZh: 深红且粘的软泥怪。

monsters.name: Crimson Templar John
monsters.desc:
Where you once saw a warrior bathed in light, whom in an other life you could have even respected, you now see only hatred.
This warrior's once glowing armor now emits a sinister crimson light. As he marches towards you can see his eyes, they are empty.
monsters.descZh:
这位曾经沐浴在阳光下的战士，一位你曾经尊敬的勇士，现在已经被仇恨所吞噬。
这个战士曾经闪耀着光辉的护甲已经被阴沉的血红色掩盖。他径直向你冲来，只见他的眼神空洞无物。

monsters.name: Crimson Templar John
monsters.desc:
Where you once saw a warrior bathed in light, whom in an other life you could have even respected, you now see only hatred.
This warrior's once glowing armor now emits a sinister crimson light. As he marches towards your foes you can see his eyes, they are empty.
monsters.descZh:
这位曾经沐浴在阳光下的战士，一位你曾经尊敬的勇士，现在已经被仇恨所吞噬。
这个战士曾经闪耀着光辉的护甲已经被阴沉的血红色掩盖。他径直冲向你的敌人，只见他的眼神空洞无物。

monsters.name: crimson crystal
monsters.desc: A formation of crimson crystal. It emits a crimson light reminiscent of blood.
monsters.descZh: 一个通体由深红色水晶构成的生物，它通体散发着血红色的光芒。

monsters.name: abyssal horror
monsters.desc: This pitch black form is shrouded in darkness. All you can make out are a pair of deep red eyes, hidden behind a mass of tentacles.
monsters.descZh: 这个深黑的物体被黑暗围绕，你只能认出一对猩红的眼睛，藏在一堆触手后面。

monsters.name: The Face of the Deep
monsters.desc: This creature sells runes and infusions for the sanctuary.
monsters.descZh: 这个生物在避难所出售纹身和符文。

monsters.name: temporal stalker
monsters.desc: A slender metallic monstrosity with long claws in place of fingers, and razor-sharp teeth.
monsters.descZh: 瘦长的金属怪物，它有着金属的爪子和锋利的牙齿。

monsters.name: guardian of reality
monsters.desc: A stern-looking guardian, ever vigilant against the threats of the paradox.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的守卫，他时刻警惕着对零点圣域的威胁。

monsters.name: Temporal Defiler
monsters.desc: A huge, slender, metallic monstrosity with long claws in place of fingers, and razor-sharp teeth. It seems to seek something here.
monsters.descZh: 一只瘦长的生物，在其手指部位有着锋利的剃刀般的爪子，此外，它还拥有锋利的牙齿。它似乎在这里寻找着什么。

monsters.name: ogre rune-spinner
monsters.desc: A towering ogre guard, her skin covered in runes and arcane designs.
monsters.descZh: 一个高大的食人魔守卫，她的身上印刻着充满魔力的符文。

monsters.name: ogre rune-spinner
monsters.desc: A towering ogre guard, her skin covered in runes.
monsters.descZh: 一个高大的食人魔守卫，她的身上印刻着充满魔力的符文。

monsters.name: ogre sentry
monsters.desc: This greatsword-wielding ogre looks at you with contempt and hatred.
monsters.descZh: 这个挥舞着大剑的食人魔用带着鄙视和仇恨的眼神凝视着你。

monsters.name: ogre sentry
monsters.desc: This greatsword-wielding ogre looks at you with contempt and hatred.
monsters.descZh: 这个挥舞着大剑的食人魔用带着鄙视和仇恨的眼神凝视着你。

monsters.name: ogre guard
monsters.desc: A maul-wield ogre. Ready to CRUSH!
monsters.descZh: 一个手里拿着重锤的食人魔，随时准备将你一锤击碎。

monsters.name: ogre pounder
monsters.desc: This ogre closes in fast on you, arms open for the hug of death.
monsters.descZh: 这个食人魔快速地接近你，张开他死亡的拥抱。

monsters.name: ogre warmaster
monsters.desc: A master of combat, she is impatient to test her newfound skills.
monsters.descZh: 一个精于战斗技巧的食人魔，她已经等不及在你身上试试自己的新技能了。

monsters.name: ogre mauler
monsters.desc: Crush! Destroy! Maim!
monsters.descZh: 冲击！碾碎！摧毁一切！

monsters.name: ghoul
monsters.desc: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.
monsters.descZh: 肉块正在不断的从这个腐朽的身体上掉落。

monsters.name: ghoulking
monsters.desc: Stench rises from this rotting abomination. Its brow is adorned with gold, and it moves at you with hatred gleaming in its eyes.
monsters.descZh: 这具腐烂的身躯散发着一股恶臭。它的脊背用金子装饰着，当它在你的面前闪过时你看到了它眼睛里的仇恨。

monsters.name: slimy ooze
monsters.desc: It's very slimy and it's oozing.
monsters.descZh: 粘糊糊的软泥怪。

monsters.name: Massok the Dragonslayer
monsters.desc: A huge and heavily-scarred orc with a gigantic sword. His helm is fashioned from a dragon's skull.
monsters.descZh: 手持巨剑、身披重甲的兽人。他的头盔由一只龙的头骨做成。

monsters.name: reaver
monsters.desc: A warrior of death.
monsters.descZh: 致命的战士。

monsters.name: Brotoq the Reaver
monsters.desc: A huge orc blocks your way to the Iron Council. You must pass.
monsters.descZh: 一只阻挡了通向钢铁议会道路的兽人。你必须打倒他。

monsters.name: Protector Myssil
monsters.desc: A Halfling Ziguranth, clad in dark steel plates. She is the current leader of Zigur.
monsters.descZh: 一名身穿黑色板甲的半身人伊格兰斯。她是伊格目前的首领。

monsters.name: Norgos, the Guardian
monsters.desc: This ancient bear long guarded the western side of the forest, but as of late he started growing mad, attacking even the Thaloren.
monsters.descZh: 这只远古巨熊一直守护着西边的丛林，但是不知何时他变的疯狂并到处攻击自然精灵们。

monsters.name: The One That Hunts
monsters.desc: And your thought radiant horrors were bad.

monsters.name: The One That Hunts
monsters.desc: The relentless hunter. It never gives up, never surrenders.
monsters.descZh: 不息的狩猎者，他永不放弃，永不投降。

monsters.name: orc baby
monsters.desc: Crawling on all fours, this green-skinned creature is far from cute, with vicious little sharp teeth and nails, and slime still sticking to its skin.
monsters.descZh: 虽然只能用四肢在地上爬行，这只绿皮生物和可爱却丝毫没有关联。它有着锋利的牙齿和指甲，并且它的皮肤上沾了一层粘糊糊的液体。

monsters.name: orc cryomancer
monsters.desc: An orc dressed in cold blue robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
monsters.descZh: 一只身穿冰蓝色长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

monsters.name: orc assassin
monsters.desc: An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.
monsters.descZh: 一个掌握刺杀和潜行的兽人刺客。

monsters.name: orc master assassin
monsters.desc: An orc trained in the secret ways of assassination, stealthy and deadly.
monsters.descZh: 一个掌握刺杀和潜行的兽人刺客。

monsters.name: orc fighter
monsters.desc: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a shield and a deadly axe.
monsters.descZh: 一只身穿板甲的兽人，装备有一面盾牌和一个致命的斧头。

monsters.name: orc corruptor
monsters.desc: An orc dressed in putrid robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
monsters.descZh: 一只穿着破烂长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

monsters.name: orc child
monsters.desc: This small orc has a malicious and greedy look in its eyes. Its veins pulse with new life and it moves with surprising speed. Though not fully developed you can still see the muscles forming on its long limbs, leading to clawed fingers and toes.
monsters.descZh: 这只小兽人的眼里透露着怨恨和贪婪。它有着旺盛的活力并能以惊人的速度移动。虽然还没完全长大，但是你能看到他全身上下微微隆起的肌肉。

monsters.name: orc retaliator
monsters.desc: A stern-looking orc, armed to the teeth.
monsters.descZh: 一个严肃的兽人，武装到牙齿

monsters.name: orc archer
monsters.desc: He is a hardy, well-weathered survivor.
monsters.descZh: 它是一个勇敢的，历经多次战争洗礼的幸存者。

monsters.name: orc gunslinger
monsters.desc: A nasty looking orc armed with double steamguns.
monsters.descZh: 一个严肃的兽人，手拿双枪。

monsters.name: orc gunslinger
monsters.desc: A nasty looking orc armed with double steamguns.
monsters.descZh: 一个严肃的兽人，手拿双枪。

monsters.name: orc berserker
monsters.desc: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a huge axe.
monsters.descZh: 一只身穿板甲的兽人，手里握着一把巨斧。

monsters.name: orc pyromancer
monsters.desc: An orc dressed in bright red robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
monsters.descZh: 一只身穿亮红色长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

monsters.name: orc mage-hunter
monsters.desc: An orc clad in massive armour. Magic seems to die down all around him.
monsters.descZh: 一只穿着板甲的兽人，魔法能量在它的周围湮灭。

monsters.name: orc master wyrmic
monsters.desc: A fierce soldier-orc highly trained in the discipline of dragons.
monsters.descZh: 一个彪悍的、经过龙战士训练的兽人士兵。

monsters.name: orc mother
monsters.desc:
This giant, bloated form towers above you. Mucus and slime ooze from every orifice, dripping onto the cavern floor. Orc children fight over the right to feed from her distended teats whilst small babies are regularly emerge from folds of flesh. The sight and the smell make you retch.
Here stands a tremendous form almost the size of a dragon. Bloated skin rises in thick folds, seeping viscous slime from its wide pores. Hundreds of hanging teats feed a small army of squabbling, fighting young orcs - only the toughest of them are able to gain the precious nutrients to grow stronger, the weaker ones left to wither on the mouldy floor. At the top of this towering hulk is a shrivelled head coated in long tangled hair. Dazed eyes peer out with a mixture of sadness and pain, but as they fix on you they turn to anger, the creature's face contorted with the fierce desire to protect its young.
monsters.descZh: 站在我们面前的是一只跟龙差不多体型的怪物。皮肤下鼓起了无数浮肿的肉块，粗大的毛孔里不断流淌出粘稠的液体。上百个乳头喂养了一批互相争吵打斗的兽人——只有最强壮的才能获得补充营养的优先权，弱小的只能在地上等待死亡。数十个生殖器在不断的抽动，不时的挤出新的兽人。在这只怪物的头顶是一头蓬乱长发的枯萎面容，茫然的眼神中混合着些许悲伤和痛苦。但是当她看到你时，她变的异常愤怒，她愤怒的面孔里透露着她护子的决心。

monsters.name: orc soldier
monsters.desc: A fierce soldier-orc.
monsters.descZh: 一个勇猛的兽人士兵。

monsters.name: orc guard
monsters.desc: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

monsters.name: orc necromancer
monsters.desc: An orc dressed in black robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
monsters.descZh: 一只身穿黑色长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

monsters.name: orc blood mage
monsters.desc: An orc dressed in blood-stained robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
monsters.descZh: 一只穿着鲜血斑斑长袍的兽人。它在用嘶哑的声音低语。

monsters.name: orc warrior
monsters.desc: He is a hardy, well-weathered survivor.
monsters.descZh: 它是一个勇敢的，历经多次战争洗礼的幸存者。

monsters.name: orc warrior
monsters.desc: A fierce soldier-orc.
monsters.descZh: 一个勇猛的兽人士兵。

monsters.name: orc summoner
monsters.desc: A fierce orc attuned to the wilds.
monsters.descZh: 一个可以和自然交流的兽人。

monsters.name: Rat Lich
monsters.desc: The master of the pit is before you. It squeaks with menace as it and a horde of minions approach you.
monsters.descZh: 这只军团的主人站在你面前。它吱吱叫着并指挥一大群怪物接近你。

monsters.name: treant
monsters.desc: A very strong near-sentient tree, which has become hostile to other living things.
monsters.descZh: 一棵有着极强近距离感知的树，它对周围的生物造成了威胁。

monsters.name: dendritic hemospinner
monsters.desc: This strange cell can somehow connect to Eyal itself.
monsters.descZh: 这个奇怪的细胞似乎可以通过某种方法连接到埃亚尔本身。

monsters.name: Chronolith Twin
monsters.desc: A six-armed creature, dressed in robes, with black insectile eyes.
monsters.descZh: 身穿长袍、有着昆虫样复眼的六臂生物。

monsters.name: two hander weapons crafter
monsters.desc: This yeek has all sorts of two handed weapons to sell.
monsters.descZh: 这名夺心魔出售所有种类的双手武器。

monsters.name: Shardskin
monsters.desc: This crystalline structure seems to be filled with a malevolent aura. Through the crystal surface you can still see the remains of what once was a huge tree.
monsters.descZh: 这个水晶一样的生物内部似乎充满了邪恶能量，透过水晶表面，你似乎还能看到里面曾是树的部分。

monsters.name: Shax the Slimy
monsters.desc: A huge troll, he seems to be adapted to aquatic life.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的巨魔，他似乎已经习惯了水中的生活。

monsters.name: Necromancer
monsters.desc: A Human dressed in black robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue. He seems to think you are his slave.
monsters.descZh: 一位穿着黑色长袍的人类。他发出刺耳的声音，看起来他想把你变为他的奴隶。

monsters.name: mastocytic feeder
monsters.desc: A reddish attack cell that will crawl to you to distract you while the rest of the organism attacks.
monsters.descZh: 一团红色的攻击细胞，它会爬到你的身边，在其他器官攻击你的时候分散你的注意力。

monsters.name: ravaging entropic rip
monsters.desc: A strange crystal/tear in the fabric of reality. You dare not think how it came to be.
monsters.descZh: 撕裂了现实的一团奇怪的水晶。你不敢想它是从哪里来的。

monsters.name: acidic digestor
monsters.desc: You look like nutriments.
monsters.descZh: 看来你看起来是某种营养物质。

monsters.name: wretchling
monsters.desc: Acid oozes all over this small demon's skin.  Beware, they tend to hunt in packs.
monsters.descZh: 酸液从这只小恶魔的身体上渗出。当心，它们喜欢群体行动。

monsters.name: xorn
monsters.desc: A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的土元素。它有四只巨大的手臂，并且可以融合泥土。

monsters.name: sunwall archer
monsters.desc: You see an archer with his bow drawn back, and a golden sun embossed on his armor.
monsters.descZh: 你看到了一个拉着弓的射手，他的护甲上有金色太阳的压纹。

monsters.name: sunwall guard
monsters.desc: This guard stands tall and proud, wearing the symbol of the Sunwall.
monsters.descZh: 这个身着太阳堡垒徽记的守卫挺拔而骄傲的站立着。

monsters.name: sunwall vindicator
monsters.desc: This mean looking soldier of the Sunwall holds steady his big two handed weapon, looking dangerously at you.
monsters.descZh: 这个看上去十分凶恶的太阳堡垒士兵稳稳地握着一柄双手剑，他正在用危险的目光看着你。

monsters.name: sun-mage
monsters.desc: A mage dressed in shining robes.
monsters.descZh: 一个穿着闪亮法袍的法师。

monsters.name: sun-mage recruit
monsters.desc: A mage dressed in glowing robes.
monsters.descZh: 一个穿着荧光法袍的法师。

monsters.name: sun paladin
monsters.desc: Warriors from afar. They wield the power of light, and a mean sword.
monsters.descZh: 来自远方的战士。他们擅长光魔法和华丽的剑技。

monsters.name: sun paladin
monsters.desc: The shield and sword of this soldier glow with a bright light. You see a golden sun engraved in the shield's center.
monsters.descZh: 这个士兵的盾牌与剑都闪耀着强光。你看到盾牌的中央雕刻着一个金色的太阳。

monsters.name: High Sun Paladin Aeryn
monsters.desc: A beautiful woman, clad in shining plate armour. Power radiates from her.
monsters.descZh: 一位身披板甲的美女。她的周身闪耀着光辉。

monsters.name: High Sun Paladin Aeryn
monsters.desc: A beautiful woman, clad in shining plate armour. Power radiates from her.
monsters.descZh: 一位身披板甲的美女。她的周身闪耀着光辉。

monsters.name: High Sun Paladin Aeryn
monsters.desc: A beautiful woman, clad in shining plate armour. Power radiates from her.
monsters.descZh: 一位身披板甲的美女。她的周身闪耀着光辉。

monsters.name: Sun Paladin Guren
monsters.desc: A Human warrior, clad in shining plate armour. Power radiates from him.
monsters.descZh: 一位身披板甲的人类战士。他身上洋溢着光辉。

monsters.name: sun paladin recruit
monsters.desc: The shield of this soldier glows with a bright light. You see a golden sun engraved in its center, and he carries a sword in his other hand.
monsters.descZh: 这个士兵的盾牌闪耀着强光。你看到盾牌的中央雕刻着一个金色的太阳，同时他的另一只手拿着一柄剑。

monsters.name: sun orb
monsters.desc: A small orb infused with the power of the Sun.
monsters.descZh: 一个注入了太阳能量的小球。

monsters.name: Tannen
monsters.desc: The traitor has been revealed, and he does not intend to let you escape to tell the tale.
monsters.descZh: 这个叛徒表示，他并不打算让你逃脱来告诉别人这件事。

monsters.name: The Shade of Telos
monsters.desc: Everybody thought Telos dead and his spirit destroyed, but it seems he still lingers in his old place of power.
monsters.descZh: 所有人都认为泰勒已经形神俱灭了，但现在看起来他似乎仍徘徊在他的能量之源。

monsters.name: titanic horror
monsters.desc: While a titan usually look like a corrupted steam giant, this one looks more like a giant-sized horrific mass of living flesh.
monsters.descZh: 尽管一般的泰坦看上去像是一个堕落的蒸汽巨人，这一个看上去更像是一个巨人大小的恐怖血肉团块。

monsters.name: titan vile spewer
monsters.desc: The wretched titan's skin is of a sickly green, full of ever-oozing wounds, cracks and pustules. Worms and all kind of vile things crawl over it.
monsters.descZh: 这个恶心的泰坦的皮肤呈现一种粘乎乎的绿色，满是不停的流着粘液的伤口，裂缝，和脓疱。蠕虫和其他各种卑劣的东西在他身上爬来爬去。

monsters.name: titan battlesmasher
monsters.desc: This creature looks like one of the steam giants, but nastier, bigger and somehow corrupted by unknown forces. Oh and it is wielding a huge maul too!
monsters.descZh: 这个生物看上去像是一个蒸汽巨人，但是更巨大，更恶心，并且被某种未知力量腐化了。天啊，他还拿着一个巨锤！

monsters.name: titan dreadnought
monsters.desc: One of the biggest titans you have seen yet, it is fully clad in deep black stralite full plate, charging menacingly towards you at a terrible pace.
monsters.descZh: 这是你见过的最大的泰坦，他被一身深黑色的蓝锆石全身甲所覆盖，正迈着可怕的步伐向你冲来。

monsters.name: titan searing seer
monsters.desc: Wreathed in arcane flames you can feel the intense psionic forces ripping at your mind emanating from this titan.
monsters.descZh: 你能感受到从这个被奥术火焰所环绕的泰坦所放射出的强大的精神力量正在你的心灵中回荡。

monsters.name: Rungof the Warg Titan
monsters.desc: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, thrice the size of a normal warg.
monsters.descZh: 这只狼比普通座狼大三倍，它正用狡猾的眼神看着你。

monsters.name: Kra'Tor the Gluttonous
monsters.desc: A morbidly obese orc with greasy pockmarked skin and oily long black hair.  He's clad in plate mail and carries a huge granite battleaxe that's nearly as large as he is.
monsters.descZh: 一只肥胖过度的兽人，他有一头油腻的黑色长发，皮肤油腻且长满了痘痘。他身穿板甲，手握一个几乎和他一样大的花岗岩双手斧。

monsters.name: ravenous horror
monsters.desc: A vile looking liquid flows from the teeth of this agile monster. It glides through the water towards you, spined fins jutting outwards.
monsters.descZh: 这个丑陋怪物的牙齿中不断滴落邪恶的液体。

monsters.name: scourge wyrm
monsters.desc: An old and powerful scourge drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条年长且强大的天谴龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: scourge drake
monsters.desc: A mature scourge drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一条成年天谴龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

monsters.name: scourge drake hatchling
monsters.desc: A drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
monsters.descZh: 一条幼龙。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

monsters.name: Kroltar the Scourge
monsters.desc: Kroltar, the mightiest fire wyrm to have ever walked Eyal. It was said that a group of dwarves had slain him, but something has taken up residence in the once proud creature's body, reanimating it into a twisted new lifeform.
monsters.descZh: 库洛塔，埃亚尔历史上最为伟大的火龙。传说矮人远征队杀死了他，不过另外一些东西似乎占据了这个曾经骄傲的巨龙的躯体，让它重新变成一种新的扭曲的生命形态。

monsters.name: necropsych's ghost
monsters.desc: The spirit of a recently deceased necropsych. It moans painfully but seems impervious to most worldly things.
monsters.descZh: 这是一个在近期死亡的通灵师的灵魂。它痛苦的哀鸣着，无视现实世界的一切。

monsters.name: Companion Archer
monsters.desc: This elf is a companion of Berethh. He's dressed in light armor and wields a bow.
monsters.descZh: 这个精灵弓手是贝里斯的同伴。他身穿皮甲，手拿长弓。

monsters.name: Companion Warrior
monsters.desc: This elf is a companion of Berethh. He's dressed in light armor and wields a sword.
monsters.descZh: 这个精灵战士是贝里斯的同伴。他身穿皮甲，手拿长剑。

monsters.name: copperhead snake
monsters.desc: It has a copper head and sharp venomous fangs.
monsters.descZh: 它有坚硬的脑袋和锋利的毒牙。

monsters.name: shadow of pain
monsters.desc: A shadowy embodiment of pain.
monsters.descZh: 一团由痛苦具现成的阴影。

monsters.name: master slinger
monsters.desc: Expert slingers on hire by the arena. They are great at their jobs.
monsters.descZh: 受竞技场雇佣的投石索大师。他们非常专业。

monsters.name: slinger
monsters.desc: Ranged fighters coming to the arena looking for wealth and glory, just like you.
monsters.descZh: 前来竞技场寻求财富和荣誉的远程斗士，就像你我一样。

monsters.name: brittle clear ooze
monsters.desc: It's translucent and it's oozing.
monsters.descZh: 半透明且粘的软泥怪。

monsters.name: spitting spider
monsters.desc: A huge arachnid, it sprays venom at its prey.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的蛛形纲动物，它向猎物喷射毒液。

monsters.name: devourer
monsters.desc: A headless, round creature with stubby legs and arms.  Its body seems to be all teeth.
monsters.descZh: 一只无头怪物，它有着圆润的体型和又粗又短的四肢。它的牙齿似乎占据了整个身体。

monsters.name: dredge
monsters.desc: A hulking pink-skinned creature with long arms as thick as tree trunks.  It drags its knuckles on the ground as it lumbers toward you.
monsters.descZh: 一只灰色皮肤的生物，它的手臂像树干一样粗壮有力。它拖动着膝关节，缓慢的向你爬过来。

monsters.name: dredge captain
monsters.desc: A thin pink-skinned creature with long spindly arms.  Half its body is old and wrinkly, and the other half appears quite young.
monsters.descZh: 一只灰色皮肤的生物，它的手臂像树干一样粗壮有力。它的半边身体又老又皱，另外半边身体则显得格外年轻。

monsters.name: Valfren Loren
monsters.desc: A massive suit of armor with a massive axe containing a massively cursed person. He is cursed to fight eternally.
monsters.descZh: 身穿重甲手持巨斧的被诅咒之人。他被诅咒战斗不止。

monsters.name: Pale Drake
monsters.desc: A malevolent skeleton archmage that has taken control of the Dreadfell since the Master's demise.
monsters.descZh: 一位邪恶的骷髅法师，自从领主大人死后，他便继承了恐惧王座。

monsters.name: undead drake
monsters.desc: A skeletal drake, armed with a deadly breath weapon and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一只骷髅飞龙，有着致命的吐息和可怕的利爪。

monsters.name: necrotic mass
monsters.desc: This putrid mass of rotting flesh shifts and quivers, but shows no signs of intelligence or mobility.
monsters.descZh: 这块腐烂的血肉不断变形颤抖，不过似乎没有智力和移动力。

monsters.name: undead wyrm
monsters.desc: The skeleton of a long-lived wyrm, armed with a deadly breath weapon and nasty claws.
monsters.descZh: 一只活了很久的巨龙的骷髅，有着致命的吐息和可怕的利爪。

monsters.name: undead drake hatchling
monsters.desc: A skeletal drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but if it's anything like living ones, it's probably not alone.
monsters.descZh: 一只骷髅幼龙；并不怎么强，但是如果他们的习性还像活着的时候那样的话，这里恐怕有不止一只。

monsters.name: necrotic abomination
monsters.desc: This monstrous form of putrid, torn flesh and chipped bone drags its mass towards you, spurting blood and viscera along the way.
monsters.descZh: 这块腐烂的被切碎的血肉，挣扎着向你移动，在路上喷出的血液和内脏。

monsters.name: shadow of despair
monsters.desc: A shadowy embodiment of despair.
monsters.descZh: 一团由绝望具现成的阴影。

monsters.name: Great Tentacly Being
monsters.desc:
You can not comprehend what you're seeing.
#{bold}##CRIMSON#These beings would squash you like a bug if you even tried to interfere in their combat.#{normal}#
monsters.descZh:
你无法理解你看到了什么。
#{bold}##CRIMSON#你知道，如果你试图干涉他们的战斗，这些东西会如同对待虫子一样轻松把你捏碎。#{normal}#
