monsters.name: Half-Finished Bone Giant
monsters.desc:
A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
This specimen looks like it was hastily assembled and is not really complete yet.
monsters.descZh:
一只铁塔一样的怪物，由上百只尸体的骨头组成。它周身环绕着不洁的光环。
这只看起来体型较小，似乎尚未完成。

monsters.name: Ungolë
monsters.desc: A huge spider, shrouded in darkness, her red glowing eyes darting to fix on you. She looks hungry.
monsters.descZh: 一只被黑暗围绕的巨大蜘蛛，她用血红的眼睛盯着你。她看起来很饥渴。

monsters.name: natural infusions
monsters.desc: This yeek has all sorts of infusions to sell.
monsters.descZh: 这名夺心魔出售所有种类的纹身。

monsters.name: midge swarm
monsters.desc: A swarm of midges; they want blood.
monsters.descZh: 一群蚊子，它们渴望鲜血。

monsters.name: Walrog
monsters.desc: Walrog, the lord of Water, is fearsome to behold. The water writhes around him as if trying to escape, making his form indistinct. He does not seem surprised to see you.
monsters.descZh: 乌尔罗格，水之主，是水中的恐怖恶魔。水如同想要逃离一般在他的周围沸腾，使他的影子若隐若现。他面对你的表情似乎并不惊讶。

monsters.name: Walrog
monsters.desc: Walrog, the lord of Water, is #AQUAMARINE#fearsome#LAST# to behold. The water boils and writhes around him as if trying to escape, frothing steam making his form indistinct.  He does not seem surprised to see you.
monsters.descZh: 乌尔罗格，水之主，是水中的#AQUAMARINE#恐怖#LAST#恶魔。水如同想要逃离一般在他的周围沸腾，蔓延的蒸汽使他的影子若隐若现。他面对你的表情似乎并不惊讶。

monsters.name: uruivellas
monsters.desc:
This demon would look like a minotaur, if a minotaur had a fiery aura surrounding it and horns all over its body.
Oh, and it is twice as big, too.
monsters.descZh: 这只恶魔长的类似于一只拥有炽焰光环的米诺陶斯，并且这只米诺陶斯全身长满了尖角。哦，还有两倍大的体型……

monsters.name: champion of Urh'Rok
monsters.desc: One of Urh'Rok's own champions. A thousand nightmares made flesh and screaming steel tower before you in the form of a massive, armored humanoid.
monsters.descZh: 乌鲁洛克精英卫队的一员。千年的梦魇使血肉和被诅咒的钢铁融合为一只钢铁怪物站在你面前。

monsters.name: squid
monsters.desc: Darting its many tentacles toward you, it tries to lock you down.
monsters.descZh: 它向你伸出能变形的魔爪，试图把你困住。

monsters.name: lich
monsters.desc: Having thought to discover life eternal, these beings have allowed undeath to rob them of the joys of life. Now they seek to destroy it as well.
monsters.descZh: 为了探索永恒的生命，这些人允许不死族剥夺他们的生趣。现在，他们同样在毁灭生者。

monsters.name: homeless fighter
monsters.desc: Will fight for a meal.
monsters.descZh: 为一餐温饱而战！

monsters.name: headless horror
monsters.desc: A headless, gangly humanoid with a large distended stomach.
monsters.descZh: 一个由闪光水晶构成的生物，它通体围绕着球状的光芒。

monsters.name: headless horror
monsters.desc: A headless gangly humanoid with a large distended stomach. Was captured and tamed by the first master of the arena.
monsters.descZh: 一只高高瘦瘦的无头人形怪物，它有着巨大的胃。它被竞技场的第一任主人捕获并生存至今。

monsters.name: armoured skeleton warrior
monsters.desc: It feels no pain.  It moves with fluidity and strength that would tear natural muscles apart.  It must be from a fresh corpse, since its bones, armor, and weapon are all in pristine condition.  And it's furious.
monsters.descZh: 这只骷髅战士没有任何痛感，它的动作行云流水，强大的挥斩足以将常人的肌肉撕裂。它一定是来自一具新鲜的尸体：它的骨头、装甲和武器还是崭新的。并且，他仿佛怒不可遏。

monsters.name: vampire
monsters.desc: It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front teeth.
monsters.descZh: 这是一只成年吸血鬼，你注意到他有一副獠牙。

monsters.name: master vampire
monsters.desc: It is a humanoid form dressed in robes. Power emanates from its chilling frame.
monsters.descZh: 这是一只穿着长袍的人形吸血鬼，魔法波动不断的从他手中的冰焰溢出。

monsters.name: elder vampire
monsters.desc:
A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others.
It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.
monsters.descZh:
这只吸血鬼一副可怕的披长袍的不死族形象，它在漫长的岁月中偷取了许多他人的生命。
它可以奴役牺牲者们的影子来协助它

monsters.name: vampire lord
monsters.desc: A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.
monsters.descZh: 当这只可怕的生物靠近时，你感到脊背一阵发凉。

monsters.name: vampire rat
monsters.desc: Looks much like a normal rat. That is, other than the very large fangs.
monsters.descZh: 不谈那大了一号的牙齿，它看起来还算比较正常的一只老鼠。

monsters.name: shivgoroth
monsters.desc: Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.
monsters.descZh: 西弗格罗斯是强大的寒冰元素，它们被一股强大的魔法从老家里赶出来

monsters.name: shiaak venomblade
monsters.desc: A strange looking humanoid, covered in black chitinous skin. He dual wields sinuous daggers and seems bent on plunging them in your body.
monsters.descZh: 一个奇怪的人形，覆盖着黑色的角质皮肤。他双手挥舞着蜿蜒的匕首，似乎一心想把它们插入你的身体里。

monsters.name: sewer alligator
monsters.desc: How cliche!
monsters.descZh: 多么的老套！

monsters.name: Sher'Tul High Priest
monsters.desc: So they do exist! Sher'Tul! The stuff of myth and legends. The stuff of terror. The stuff of nightmares. The stuff of unlimited power. The race that turned on the gods of old and actually won. This one seems intent on resurrecting Amakthel, the most powerful of all the gods. You do not know why but this cannot happen or all Orcs, and the world, will be doomed.
monsters.descZh: 夏·图尔人！他们是存在的！神话和传奇的来源，远古的恐怖和噩梦，拥有无尽力量的强大生物，他们的种族曾经战胜了古神。这只夏·图尔人似乎想要复活阿马克泰尔，最强的神。你不知道他为什么要这么做，但你知道，如果他的阴谋得逞，兽人乃至整个世界都会遭受灭顶之灾。

monsters.name: sher'tan
monsters.desc: This abomination has the height of any other titan but its features definitively remind you of the few Sher'Tul images you have seen. Your very being rebels to the thought and sheer terror takes hold of your mind.
monsters.descZh: 这个孽物和其他泰坦差不多高，但是他的特征让你回想起了你见过的那些夏·图尔人图片。你竭尽全力的抗拒这些想法，你的心灵已被纯粹的恐惧所控制。

monsters.name: sanguine experiment
monsters.desc: It looks like a giant blood clot. Is that what its creator intended?
monsters.descZh: 它看起来就像一个巨大的血块。它的创造者到底想做啥？

monsters.name: blinkwyrm
monsters.desc: A shifting, writhing, snake-like dragon, blinking in and out of existence, just waiting for you to turn your back.
monsters.descZh: 一只不断闪烁和换位的蛇状巨龙，它只是在等你回头。

monsters.name: rattlesnake
monsters.desc: As you approach, the snake coils up and rattles its tail threateningly.
monsters.descZh: 你一靠近，这只蛇便盘旋竖起并用尾巴发出警告的声音。

monsters.name: Draebor, the Imp
monsters.desc: An intensely irritating git of a monster.
monsters.descZh: 具有强烈刺激性气味的小怪兽。

monsters.name: Pumpkin, the little kitty
monsters.desc: An orange kitty with a white star blaze on his chest. Has a strange affinity for licking your face whenever possible.
monsters.descZh: 一只橙色的小猫咪，胸前有一颗白色的星星。只要有机会就会舔你的脸颊。

monsters.name: water imp
monsters.desc: A small water demon, lobbing spells at you.
monsters.descZh: 水中的小恶魔，向你缓慢投射法术。

monsters.name: thief
monsters.desc: He eyes you and your belongings, then suddenly vanishes... strange, why is your pack lighter?
monsters.descZh: 他盯着你和你的背包，然后突然消失不见……好奇怪，你的背包似乎轻了许多？

monsters.name: lesser vampire
monsters.desc: This vampire has only just begun its new life. It has not yet fathomed its newfound power, yet it still has a thirst for blood.
monsters.descZh: 这只吸血鬼刚开始它的新生活，还不能熟练运用它的新能力，但是它同样渴望鲜血。

monsters.name: Mindcontrol Pillar
monsters.desc: A glass pillar containing a still living brain.
monsters.descZh: 这个玻璃柱子中完好地保存着一个大脑。

monsters.name: star crusader
monsters.desc: Warriors from afar. They wield the power of light, and a mean sword. Darkness, too.
monsters.descZh: 来自远方的战士。他们擅长光魔法和华丽的剑技，同样也精通暗魔法。

monsters.name: Astral-Infused Yeti
monsters.desc: You wonder how this yeti can have wandered so far from its native habitat in the Clork Peninsula. You also wonder what happened to it that produced the celestial energies-wielding creature you angrily marching towards you.
monsters.descZh: 你想知道为什么雪人会从它在克拉克半岛的栖息地跋山涉水来到这里。你还想知道为什么这个被注入了强大的天空力量的雪人会愤怒地向你冲来。

monsters.name: astral conjurer
monsters.desc: A mage dressed in ornate robes depicting both light and darkness.
monsters.descZh: 一个穿着同时描绘了光与暗的华丽法袍的法师。

monsters.name: anorithil
monsters.desc: Warriors from afar. They use the power of light and darkness against you!
monsters.descZh: 来自远方的战士。他们使用光暗魔法攻击你。

monsters.name: anorithil
monsters.desc: A mage dressed in ornate robes depicting both light and darkness.
monsters.descZh: 一个穿着同时描绘了光与暗的华丽法袍的法师。

monsters.name: mean looking elven guard
monsters.desc: An elven guard, scarred and sullen.
monsters.descZh: 一位阴沉的刀疤脸精灵守卫。

monsters.name: Ukruk the Fierce
monsters.desc: This ugly orc looks really nasty and vicious. He is obviously looking for something and bears an unknown symbol on his shield.
monsters.descZh: 这只丑陋的兽人看起来邪恶而丑陋。显然他正在寻找某物，并且他在不断的用盾牌发出信号。

monsters.name: weaver patriarch
monsters.desc: A large blue arachnid with white markings on its thorax.  It shifts and shimmers as though only partially connected to the timeline.
monsters.descZh: 一只胸部有着白色花纹的巨大蓝蜘蛛。它不断的移动和闪烁，好像它只有部分连接在时间线上。

monsters.name: thaurhereg
monsters.desc: This terrible demon is covered in blood, which flows *on* its skin in ever-changing patterns that disturb you simply when looking at it.
monsters.descZh: 这只可怕的恶魔浑身是血，鲜血在它的身上以某种形式流淌。仅仅看了一眼，你就感到浑身不舒服。

monsters.name: Spacial Disturbance
monsters.desc: A hole in the fabric of space, it seems to be the source of the expanse instability.
monsters.descZh: 一个由虚空构成的虫洞，它似乎是空间不稳的原因。

monsters.name: netherworm mass
monsters.desc: A disgusting mass of distorted worms, slithering towards you.
monsters.descZh: 一团令人厌恶的扭曲蠕虫，正在向你爬行过来。

monsters.name: Void Spectre
monsters.desc: Intense Arcane energy whirls in the air around this ethereal form.
monsters.descZh: 无尽的奥术能量在它永恒的身躯周围环绕。

monsters.name: void horror
monsters.desc: It looks like a hole in spacetime, but you get the impression it's somehow more than that.
monsters.descZh: 它乍一看像是时空中的一道缝隙，但你对它的印象远远不止于此。

monsters.name: nethergate
monsters.desc: A strange portal of nether energies, it somehow feels alive itself.
monsters.descZh: 散发着虚空能量的奇妙传送门，好像它本身是活着的。

monsters.name: cave bear
monsters.desc: It has come down from its cave foraging for food. Unfortunately, it found you.
monsters.descZh: 它已经离开洞穴觅食了许久。不幸的是，它找到了你。

monsters.name: snow giant
monsters.desc: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly.
monsters.descZh: 一只酷似人类却很高大的生物。它手握一个巨锤，看起来不是很友好。

monsters.name: snow giant chieftain
monsters.desc: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly.
monsters.descZh: 一只酷似人类却很高大的生物。它手握一个巨锤，看起来不是很友好。

monsters.name: snow giant boulder thrower
monsters.desc: A towering creature, humanoid but huge. It wields a giant maul and does not look friendly.
monsters.descZh: 一只酷似人类却很高大的生物。它手握一个巨锤，看起来不是很友好。

monsters.name: Burb the snow giant champion
monsters.desc: A maddened, enraged snow giant that towers over his comrades. You've heard legends mentioning this particular monstrosity; they say that when he's not rampaging around frothing at the mouth, he sits, almost childlike, engraving stories and mysterious patterns on any flat stone surface he can find.
monsters.descZh: 一个被激怒的、远远高于其他雪巨人的勇士。你以前听说过关于这个雪巨人的故事：据说，平时他不像现在这样愤怒的口沫横飞时，他会坐下来，像个孩子一样，在他能找到的任何一块平整的石头表面雕刻难以理解的图案。

monsters.name: snow cat
monsters.desc: A large cat with a grey fur matted with black.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的花猫。

monsters.name: yeti
monsters.desc: This large humanoid form is coated with a thick white fur.
monsters.descZh: 这个大型的类人生物身上长着厚实的白毛。

monsters.name: yeti demolisher
monsters.desc: This huge humanoid form is coated with a thick white fur, with large, vicious claws. Will you welcome the embrace of its large muscular arms?
monsters.descZh: 这个巨大的类人生物身上长着厚实的白毛，和危险的巨爪。你会喜欢被他肌肉满满的双臂拥抱一下吗？

monsters.name: attack yeti
monsters.desc: This yeti's claws are coated in sharply carved iron. It glares at you with a long trained anger.
monsters.descZh: 这个雪人的爪子上套着锋利的铁刺，狂怒的瞪着你。

monsters.name: guard yeti
monsters.desc: This yeti is large and angry, with claws far more sharply honed than those found in nature.
monsters.descZh: 这个雪人巨大且愤怒，他的爪子被打磨的远比那些野生雪人的锋利。

monsters.name: yeti warrior
monsters.desc: This huge humanoid form is coated with a thick white fur, with large, vicious claws. It looks angry.
monsters.descZh: 这个巨大的类人生物身上长着厚实的白毛，和危险的巨爪。他看上去十分愤怒。

monsters.name: yeti cub
monsters.desc: This humanoid form is coated with a thick white fur.
monsters.descZh: 这个类人生物身上长着厚实的白毛。

monsters.name: Yeti Patriarch
monsters.desc: This yeti towers over its comrades. You see a cunning in its eyes unmatched by the others.
monsters.descZh: 这个雪人比他的同胞们搞出一个头。你看到他的眼中充满了其他雪人所没有的狡猾。

monsters.name: blood mage
monsters.desc: A man dressed in black robes. You feel weak as you hear his ominous chanting.
monsters.descZh: 一位穿着黑色长袍的人。当你听到他们的低吟时，你感到一阵虚弱。

monsters.name: sanguine horror
monsters.desc: This pulsing, quivering form is a deep crimson, and appears to be composed entirely of thick, virulent blood. Waves rhythmically ripple across its surface, indicating a still beating heart somewhere in its body.
monsters.descZh: 这个不断跳动不断颤抖的物体是深红色的，似乎完全由浓厚致命的血液组成。在其表面仍有富有节奏的波纹，也许在其身上的某个地方仍有心脏跳动

monsters.name: fleshy experiment
monsters.desc: This pile of rotting flesh twitches and makes horrid noises.
monsters.descZh: 这团腐肉抽动着，发出可怕的噪音。

monsters.name: blood lich
monsters.desc: The seething, pumping, disembodied blood of a horrendously powerful necromancer. To strike it is to bathe in the rivers of the Fearscape itself.
monsters.descZh: 来自一位非常强大的死灵法师的沸腾的、跳动的、有形的血液。跟它战斗等于要饱受恶魔空间的摧残。

monsters.name: Blood Master
monsters.desc: This small humanoid is covered in silky white fur. Its bulging eyes stare deep into your mind.
monsters.descZh: 这只矮小的人形生物有着白色的毛发。他似乎能看穿你的心灵。

monsters.name: Training Dummy
monsters.desc: Training dummy.
monsters.descZh: 训练用傀儡。用它来训练吧！

monsters.name: Training Dummy
monsters.desc: Training dummy. Use it to train.
monsters.descZh: 训练用傀儡。用它来训练吧！

monsters.name: Training Dummy
monsters.desc: Training dummy. Use it to train.
monsters.descZh: 训练用傀儡。用它来训练吧！

monsters.name: martyr
monsters.desc: A devout soldier.
monsters.descZh: 一位虔诚的战士。

monsters.name: Epoch
monsters.desc: A huge being composed of sparking blue and yellow energy stands before you.  It shifts and flows as it moves, at once erratic and graceful.
monsters.descZh: 在你面前的是一只黄蓝双色能量线的混合体。它快速的闪现和移动，看起来优雅又飘逸。

monsters.name: stone troll
monsters.desc: A giant troll with scabrous black skin. With a shudder, you notice the belt of dwarf skulls around his massive waist.
monsters.descZh: 有着粗糙黑色皮肤的巨魔，一阵战栗后，你惊讶的发现他的腰带是用矮人头骨制成。

monsters.name: Bill the Stone Troll
monsters.desc:
Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for Halfling.
He is wielding a small tree trunk and lumbering toward you.
This is the troll the notes spoke about, no doubt.
monsters.descZh: 高大、强壮且嗜食半身人。他手持一柄小巧的树干并冲向你。这就是手稿里提到的那只巨魔，没跑了……

monsters.name: fire wyrmic
monsters.desc: A fire wyrmic aspiring to win the tournament. He comes paired with an ice wyrmic.
monsters.descZh: 一位立志赢得比赛的炎龙战士。他常和一位冰龙战士一起。

monsters.name: Fyrk, Faeros High Guard
monsters.desc:
Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.
This one looks even nastier and looks toward you with what seems to be disdain. Flames swirl all around him.
monsters.descZh:
炎魔是高智慧的火焰元素，在火山以外的其他地方很少看到。它们很可能不属于这个世界。
这只看起来更加凶残，它用蔑视的眼神看着你。火焰在它的身上流转。

monsters.name: king cobra
monsters.desc: It is a large snake with a hooded face.
monsters.descZh: 这是一条有冠状头部的巨蛇。

monsters.name: ghast
monsters.desc: This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs of them. It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.
monsters.descZh: 这个肮脏的生物是食尸鬼的分支，并且经常带领着一群食尸鬼。它散发着令人作呕的气息，并且它的噬咬会传播瘟疫。

monsters.name: ziguranth wyrmic
monsters.desc: A Ziguranth wilder, attuned to nature.
monsters.descZh: 一位能沟通自然的伊格兰斯自然师。

monsters.name: ziguranth warrior
monsters.desc: A Ziguranth warrior, clad in heavy armour.
monsters.descZh: 一位身穿重甲的伊格兰斯战士。

monsters.name: ziguranth summoner
monsters.desc: A Ziguranth wilder, attuned to nature.
monsters.descZh: 一位能沟通自然的伊格兰斯自然师。

monsters.name: Zemekkys, Grand Keeper of Reality
monsters.desc: A timeless elf stands before you. Even though his age is impossible to determine, you feel he has seen many things.
monsters.descZh: 一位中年精灵站在你面前，岁月不曾在其脸上留下痕迹。尽管你不知道他活了多久，但是你仍能感到他已经遍览世间万物。

monsters.name: Queen Ant
monsters.desc: Queen of the ants, queen of the biting death!
monsters.descZh: 蚂蚁皇后，掌控死亡之啮的皇后！

monsters.name: Council Member Nashal
monsters.desc: The noble features on the face of this giantess contrast heavily with the evil grin she carries and the huge rotating saws on her arms.
monsters.descZh: 这位女巨人高贵的面容与她邪恶的微笑和手中旋转的巨大链锯形成了鲜明的反差

monsters.name: Council Member Palaquie
monsters.desc: Standing proud, the giantess wields both a steamgun and a mindstar, as the bullets fly you can feel a powerful mental pressure on your mind, numbing you.
monsters.descZh: 这位女巨人骄傲的站在你面前，手中拿着蒸汽枪和灵晶，当子弹飞来时，你感觉一股强大的精神力向你冲来。

monsters.name: Council Member Pendor
monsters.desc: Wielding two huge steamguns this giant is amazingly elusive and agile for his size. Oh and very deadly!
monsters.descZh: 这位手拿两把巨大的蒸汽枪的巨人却表现出令人吃惊的敏捷和难以捉摸。十分致命！

monsters.name: Council Member Tantalos
monsters.desc: It seems like a safe assumption that the highest elected official of the Atmos Tribe was not always a hideous, titanic abomination, reminiscent of the few images of Sher'Tul you have seen, with a combination of unnatural appearance and sickening gurgling noises that revulses you on every level from intellectual and moral disgust, all the way down to a primal instinct that roars wordlessly in your mind with a fear and hatred older than any language.  If he was, his campaign's gerrymandering talents must have been legendary.
monsters.descZh: 我们应该假设气之部族的最高官员应该并不是一个面目可憎的巨大怪物。他让你联想起你对夏·图尔人的模糊印象，但这不自然的外观和令人作呕的咕噜声让你从理性到情感的每一个层面都充满厌恶。憎恶这种恐怖生物的原始本能似乎潜藏于你的心灵中，比一切语言都要古老。如果他真的是的话…好吧，他还真是个贿选高手。

monsters.name: Council Member Tormak
monsters.desc: A master in all things arcane, Tormak stands in your way, steadfast in his resolution to crush you under his mighty spells.
monsters.descZh: 作为一位奥术领域的大师，托马克正站在你的面前，试图用它强大的法术粉碎你。

monsters.name: Weirdling Beast
monsters.desc: A roughly humanoid creature, with tentacle-like appendages in the place of arms and legs. You gasp in horror as you notice it has no head. Putrid warts form quickly on its skin and explode as quickly.
monsters.descZh: 一只类人生物，在四肢的位置它长出了触须状的关节。当你发现他没有头时你吓了一跳。瘤状物在它的皮肤上不断的冒出又爆炸。

monsters.name: Haze Commander Parmor
monsters.desc: The Commander of the G.E.M. this noble looking giant looks down upon you in contempt. She wields two huge rotating saws still covered in various horror entrails.
monsters.descZh: G.E.M.的指挥官。这个高贵的巨人用藐视的眼神居高临下地看着你。她手里拿着两个巨大的旋转圆锯，上面还带有恐魔的内脏。

monsters.name: shadow stalker
monsters.desc: A shadow, almost humanoid in shape. It seems to move carefully and with cunning before swiftly striking.
monsters.descZh: 一个影子，看起来几乎是人类的形状。它狡猾地闪现，出其不意地发动攻击。

monsters.name: shadow claw
monsters.desc: A shadow, almost humanoid in shape. Long claws extend in front of it as is swims through the air.
monsters.descZh: 一个影子，看起来几乎是人类的形状。长长的触手在它面前延伸，如同在空气中游动。

monsters.name: shadow claw
monsters.desc: A shadow, almost humanoid in shape. At times its form seems to be a force of will rather than something real.
monsters.descZh: 一个影子，看起来几乎是人类的形状。有时它的形态看上去不像是某种真实存在的物体，而是某种意志的力量。

monsters.name: shadowblade
monsters.desc: Stealthy fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will steal your life!
monsters.descZh: 隐形的斗士，他们一直在追求欺诈的巅峰技巧。小心，他们会随时偷走你的生命！

monsters.name: shadowblade
monsters.desc: Stealthy fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will steal your life!
monsters.descZh: 隐形的斗士，他们一直在追求欺诈的巅峰技巧。小心，他们会随时偷走你的生命！

monsters.name: chitinous spider
monsters.desc: A huge arachnid with a massive exoskeleton.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的蛛形纲动物，它有着厚重的外壳。

monsters.name: Ureslak the Eternal
monsters.desc: The legendary Wyrm seems to have fallen, though it doesn't appear to have stuck.
monsters.descZh: 这条传奇巨龙似乎已经陨落，不过这似乎并不影响他的霸权继续统治大陆。

monsters.name: eternal bone giant
monsters.desc: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
monsters.descZh: 像铁塔一样的生物，由数不清的骨头构成。它全身围绕着邪恶的气息。

monsters.name: shalore liberator
monsters.desc: A powerful shalore brawler that came to the Sunwall as reinforcement from the Allied Kingdoms. He shall regret it!
monsters.descZh: 这个强大的永恒精灵看起来是联合王国派来支援太阳堡垒的援军。他一定会后悔来到这里的！

monsters.name: shalore student
monsters.desc: A shalore student.
monsters.descZh: 一个永恒精灵学徒

monsters.name: The Possessed
monsters.desc: He is the leader of a gang of bandits that killed the Shade of Kor'Pul, however it is obvious the Shade was merely displaced. It is now possessing the corpse of his killer.
monsters.descZh: 这是那伙杀死暗影骷髅的强盗的头目，但显然暗影骷髅上的灵魂并没有这么甘心离去，曾经不可一世的强盗头目也只是被其附体的行尸走肉罢了。

monsters.name: spectral rat
monsters.desc: An eerie haze surrounds this translucent rat.
monsters.descZh: 怪异的烟雾环绕着这只透明的老鼠。

monsters.name: swarm hive
monsters.desc: This titanic mass of flesh pulsates and churns as tiny monsters burst from its orifices.
monsters.descZh: 巨大的肉块在不断振动、摇晃，从孔口处不断涌现生物。

monsters.name: protosentient globula
monsters.desc: A huge globula of protoplasma. You can feel a kind of protosentience emanating from it, and you can tell it is hungry.
monsters.descZh: 一团球状的巨大的原生质细胞。从他的身上渗出原生质，你感觉他很饥饿。

monsters.name: protoplasmic controller
monsters.desc: Acid. Fire. Pain.
monsters.descZh: 酸液。火焰。痛苦。

monsters.name: plasmic disruptor
monsters.desc: A green oozing defence cell of the Maggot.
monsters.descZh: 这团绿色的软泥是蛆虫的防御细胞

monsters.name: Ancient Automated Teacher
monsters.desc: An ancient archive of knowledge! It seems to have some kind of vocal interface.
monsters.descZh: 一份远古知识的宝库！他似乎能和你对话。

monsters.name: ancient elven mummy
monsters.desc: An animated corpse in mummy wrappings.
monsters.descZh: 一具缠绕着裹尸布的鲜活尸体。

monsters.name: ancient dragon turtle
monsters.desc: A huge, elongated sea-green reptile, it looks old and impenetrable.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大、细长泛着海蓝色的爬行动物。看上去苍老而结实。

monsters.name: Snaproot
monsters.desc: This ancient Treant's bark is scorched almost black. It sees humanity as a scourge, to be purged.
monsters.descZh: 这棵远古巨树的树皮几乎变成了黑色。它视人类为灾难，灾难必须消灭。

monsters.name: ancient lich
monsters.desc: An elder being from a now-forgotten age, filled and fueled by its hate and rage toward all things living, it seeks to deprive all others of a prize it cannot have... life.
monsters.descZh: 一位存活了不知多少岁月的巫妖，它对这个世界和生者充满了仇恨，所以它试图去剥夺生者所拥有而它所没有的财富——生命。

monsters.name: moon orb
monsters.desc: A small orb infused with the power of the Moons.
monsters.descZh: 一个注入了月亮能量的小球。

monsters.name: xhaiak arachnomancer
monsters.desc: A strange looking humanoid spiderkin, its body half covered by a light flowing robe. It looks like tiny spiders are crawling on his skin.
monsters.descZh: 一个奇怪的人形蜘蛛，它的身体一半被流光的长袍覆盖。看起来小蜘蛛正在他的皮肤上爬行。

monsters.name: The Abomination
monsters.desc: A horrid mass of pustulent flesh, sinew, and bone; this creature seems to constantly be in pain. Two heads glare malevolently at you, an intruder in its domain.
monsters.descZh: 一只由无数碎肉、肌腱和骨头组成的恐怖混合体，它看起来痛苦万分。它的双头恶毒的看着你，因为你闯入了它的地盘。

monsters.name: patchwork troll
monsters.desc: A disgusting and mismatched construct of necromantically-enhanced troll bits and shattered weapons. Confused and furious, it rends and shatters its surroundings with impossible strength, moving with speed found nowhere in nature.
monsters.descZh: 一只由死灵法术拼接而成的挥舞着武器的恶心巨魔。它用不可思议的力量摧毁周围的一切，令人困惑的是，它的移动速度也世所罕见。

monsters.name: ogric abomination
monsters.desc: This ogre seems to have tried to graft golem parts on its own body. To various interresting results.
monsters.descZh: 这个食人魔似乎试图把傀儡的身躯嫁接在自己的身体上。各种意义上有趣的结果。

monsters.name: gelatinous cube
monsters.desc:
It is a strange, vast gelatinous structure that assumes cubic proportions as it lines all four walls of the corridors it patrols.
Through its transparent jelly structure you can see treasures it has engulfed, and a few corpses as well.
monsters.descZh: 这是一个奇怪的、巨大的凝胶状的立方体结构，它沿着走廊的四壁巡逻。通过它的透明果冻状结构，你可以看到它吞噬的宝物和一些尸体。

monsters.name: war bear
monsters.desc: Bears with tusks, trained to kill.
monsters.descZh: 被训练过杀人技巧的獠牙巨熊。

monsters.name: Warmaster Gnarg
monsters.desc: This ugly orc looks really nasty and vicious. He wields a huge two-handed sword and means to use it.
monsters.descZh: 这名丑陋的兽人看起来阴险狡诈。他手持双手大剑并擅长此道。

monsters.name: Horned Horror
monsters.desc: Some horrible power has twisted this brutish minotaur into something altogether more terrifying. Huge tentacles undulate from its back as it clenches and unclenches its powerful fists.
monsters.descZh: 可怕的能量让这个米诺陶转变成更加恐怖的怪物，它的背上伸出触手，正在四处伸展游走，时而缠绕在它的拳头上。

monsters.name: steam defence turret
monsters.desc:
This appears to be mechanized pedestal.
Two steamguns mounted on its top constantly swivel back and forth, seeking enemies of the Atmos.
monsters.descZh:
这似乎是机械化的底座。
两个蒸汽枪安装在它的顶部，不断来回旋转，寻找气之部族的敌人。

monsters.name: steam drone
monsters.desc: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. A huge clonking spider that runs to you at great speed ready to cut you to pieces with its two rotating saws in place of mandibles.
monsters.descZh: 这是个看上去很像蜘蛛的八腿机械构造体。它正向你飞速冲来并准备用颚部的旋转锯刃将你撕成碎片。

monsters.name: steam giant flameshot
monsters.desc: This steam giant carries a steamgun in each hand. The barrels appear to be flaming.
monsters.descZh: 这个蒸汽巨人双手各拿着一把枪管在燃烧的蒸汽枪。

monsters.name: steam giant gunslinger
monsters.desc: This steam giant carries a steamgun in each hand.
monsters.descZh: 这个蒸汽巨人双手各拿着一把蒸汽枪。

monsters.name: steam giant berserker
monsters.desc: This steam giant carries a massive greatsword with both hands, and you see a cloud of thick steam enveloping the blade.
monsters.descZh: 这个蒸汽巨人双手拿着一柄无比庞大的大剑，你看到剑刃被厚厚的蒸汽云团包裹着。

monsters.name: steam giant commoner
monsters.desc: Pockets of gold jingle around the waist of this giant.
monsters.descZh: 巨人的腰间传来了金币的叮当响。

monsters.name: steam giant commoner
monsters.desc: Pockets of gold jingle around the waist of this giant.
monsters.descZh: 巨人的腰间传来了金币的叮当响。

monsters.name: steam giant gunner
monsters.desc: This steam giant is carrying a powerful looking gun.
monsters.descZh: 这个蒸汽巨人拿着一把看上去威力很强的枪。

monsters.name: steam giant guard
monsters.desc: This titanic figure walks towards you, a massive sword and shield in each hand.
monsters.descZh: 这个拿着巨型剑盾的庞大人形正在向你走来。

monsters.name: steam giant scribe
monsters.desc: This well-dressed giant is is covered in ink smudges and looks somewhat alarmed.
monsters.descZh: 这个精心打扮的巨人身上满是墨水的污渍，看起来十分惊慌。

monsters.name: steam giant necropsych
monsters.desc: Covered in arcane runes of death, this steam giant means business.
monsters.descZh: 这个被死亡符文所覆盖的蒸汽巨人是个大麻烦。

monsters.name: steam giant yeti rider
monsters.desc: Riding atop a massive armored yeti, this steam giant wields a huge greatsword.
monsters.descZh: 这个拿着大剑的蒸汽巨人骑在一只重甲雪人身上。

monsters.name: steam giant blood carver
monsters.desc: Blood seems to ooze from the towering giant, yet seemingly to no ill effect.
monsters.descZh: 尽管血液不停地从这个高大的巨人身上渗出，他看上去却没有任何不适。

monsters.name: Weaver Queen
monsters.desc: A large white spider.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的白色蜘蛛。

monsters.name: Commander Fralor
monsters.desc: This heavily armored steam giant carries a huge battleaxe, swinging it menacingly towards you.
monsters.descZh: 这个身穿重甲的蒸汽巨人手持巨大的双手斧，恶狠狠挥舞着向你冲来。

monsters.name: Nain the Guide
monsters.desc: A pitchfork-wielding human with a welcoming smile.
monsters.descZh: 一名带着微笑留着扫把头的人类。

monsters.name: Ukllmswwik the Wise
monsters.nameZh: 智慧的乌克勒姆斯维奇
monsters.desc: It looks like a cross between a shark and a dragon, only nastier.
monsters.descZh: 它看起来像是鲨鱼和龙的混合体，只是更加丑陋。

monsters.name: ultimate hethugoroth
monsters.desc: A swirling mass of hot vapour animated into a semblance of life.
monsters.descZh: 一个灼热的蒸汽漩涡所形成的生命体。

monsters.name: heavy bone giant
monsters.desc: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
monsters.descZh: 像铁塔一样的生物，由数不清的骨头构成。它全身围绕着邪恶的气息。

monsters.name: gem crafter
monsters.desc: This yeek has all sorts of gems to sell.
monsters.descZh: 这名夺心魔出售所有品种的宝石。

monsters.name: Limmir the Jeweler
monsters.desc: An Elven Anorithil, specializing in the art of jewelry.
monsters.descZh: 一名精灵星月术士，擅长珠宝技艺。

monsters.name: dredgling
monsters.desc: A small pink-skinned humanoid with large bulbous eyes.
monsters.descZh: 一只小小的红皮人型生物，它有着巨大的眼睛。

monsters.name: searing horror
monsters.desc: And you thought radiant horrors were bad.
monsters.descZh: 听说你觉得灼眼恐魔还不够厉害？

monsters.name: radiant horror
monsters.desc: A lanky four-armed humanoid shape composed of bright golden light.  It's so bright it's hard to look at, and you can feel heat radiating outward from it.
monsters.descZh: 一只身材瘦长的四臂人形怪物，它的身体由金色的光芒组成。它的光芒令人无法直视，你可以感受到高温从它身上不断的向外辐射。

monsters.name: Drolem
monsters.desc:
This is Tannen's construct, a HUGE golem in the rough shape of a dragon.
It is so huge that it blocks sight beyond it.
monsters.descZh: 这是泰恩的作品，一只巨大的龙形傀儡。它是如此强大，可以摧毁任何阻挡它的人。

monsters.name: Automated Defense System
monsters.desc: This heavily armored mecharachnid looks extremely dangerous and well equipped to defend the quarry.
monsters.descZh: 这个重装的机械蜘蛛看起来极其危险，全副武装，准备保卫采石场。

monsters.name: Automated Defense System
monsters.desc: This heavily armored mecharachnid looks extremely dangerous and well equipped to defend the quarry.
monsters.descZh: 这个重装的机械蜘蛛看起来极其危险，全副武装，准备保卫采石场。

monsters.name: Automated Defense System
monsters.desc: This heavily armored mecharachnid looks extremely dangerous and well equipped to defend the quarry.
monsters.descZh: 这个重装的机械蜘蛛看起来极其危险，全副武装，准备保卫采石场。

monsters.name: great gladiator
monsters.desc: Mercenaries hired by the arena for the sole purpose of entertainment. They make a living beating people up.
monsters.descZh: 只为娱乐竞技场而请的雇佣兵。他们靠娱乐群众生存。

monsters.name: giant brown ant
monsters.desc: It's a large brown ant.
monsters.descZh: 一只巨大的棕色蚂蚁。

monsters.name: brown mold
monsters.desc: A strange brown growth on the dungeon floor.
monsters.descZh: 地板上的奇特棕色植物。

monsters.name: brown bear
monsters.desc: The weakest of bears, covered in brown shaggy fur.
monsters.descZh: 有着棕色蓬松皮毛的熊。

monsters.name: hexer
monsters.desc: A man dressed in black robes. You feel a thousand curses being put on you.
monsters.descZh: 一位穿着黑色长袍的人。你感到身上中了许多诅咒。

monsters.name: xaren
monsters.desc: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.
monsters.descZh: 这是一个相对较硬的索尔石怪。它用石质护甲把闪光的内在掩盖起来。

monsters.name: last hope guard
monsters.desc: A stern-looking guard, he will not let you disturb the town.
monsters.descZh: 一名严肃的守卫，他不会允许任何人打扰镇子的宁静。

monsters.name: Harno, Herald of Last Hope
monsters.nameZh: 最后希望的传令官哈诺
monsters.desc: This is one of the heralds of Last Hope. He seems to be looking for you.
monsters.descZh: 他是最后希望传令官中的一员。他似乎找你有事。

monsters.name: shadow of guilt
monsters.desc: A shadowy embodiment of guilt.
monsters.descZh: 一团由罪怨具现成的阴影。

monsters.name: warg
monsters.desc: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning.
monsters.descZh: 这是一只狡猾且体型巨大的狼。
